2437
2438/// Return a zero-valued attribute for the given lowered HW type, recursing
2439/// into struct and array element types. Used to materialize zero values for
2440/// zero-width slots in `hw.struct_create` / `hw.array_create` operands.
2441///
2442/// The recursion is required because FIRRTL allows arbitrarily nested
2443/// aggregates of zero-width content (e.g. `bundle<a: bundle<b: uint<0>>>`).
2444/// Such a type lowers to a correspondingly nested HW aggregate (here
2445/// `!hw.struct<a: !hw.struct<b: i0>>`), and `hw.aggregate_constant` requires
2446/// the supplied `ArrayAttr` to mirror that nesting structure.
2447Attribute FIRRTLLowering::getZeroAttributeForType(Type type) {
2448 if (auto intType = hw::type_dyn_cast<IntegerType>(type))
2449 return builder.getIntegerAttr(intType, 0);
2450 if (auto array = hw::type_dyn_cast<hw::ArrayType>(type)) {
2451 // All array elements share a single type, and every slot needs the same
2452 // zero value, so we build the recursive zero attribute once and replicate
2453 // it. No reverse is necessary as all the types are the same.
2454 auto element = getZeroAttributeForType(array.getElementType());
2455 SmallVector<Attribute> values(array.getNumElements(), element);
2456 return builder.getArrayAttr(values);
2457 }
2458 if (auto structType = hw::type_dyn_cast<hw::StructType>(type)) {
2459 SmallVector<Attribute> values;
2460 values.reserve(structType.getElements().size());
2461 for (auto &field : structType.getElements())
2462 values.push_back(getZeroAttributeForType(field.type));
2463 return builder.getArrayAttr(values);
2464 }
2465 llvm_unreachable("unsupported lowered type for zero attribute");
2466}
2467
2468/// Return a zero-valued constant for the given lowered HW type. Used to fill
2469/// in zero-width slots in `hw.struct_create` / `hw.array_create` when the
2470/// corresponding FIRRTL operand was lowered away.
2471Value FIRRTLLowering::getZeroValueForType(Type type) {
2472 if (auto intType = hw::type_dyn_cast<IntegerType>(type))
2473 return getOrCreateIntConstant(intType.getWidth(), 0);
2474 return hw::AggregateConstantOp::create(
2475 builder, type, cast<ArrayAttr>(getZeroAttributeForType(type)));
2476}
2477
2478/// Return the lowered HW value corresponding to the specified original value.
2479/// This returns a null value for FIRRTL values that haven't be lowered, e.g.
2480/// unknown width integers. This returns hw::inout type values if present, it
2481/// does not implicitly read from them.
2482Value FIRRTLLowering::getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(Value value) {
2483 // If we lowered this value, then return the lowered value, otherwise fail.
2484 if (auto lowering = valueMapping.lookup(value)) {
2485 assert(!isa<FIRRTLType>(lowering.getType()) &&
2486 "Lowered value should be a non-FIRRTL value");
2487 return lowering;
2488 }
2489 return Value();
2490}
2491
2492/// Return the lowered value corresponding to the specified original value.
2493/// This returns a null value for FIRRTL values that cannot be lowered, e.g.
2494/// unknown width integers.
2495Value FIRRTLLowering::getLoweredValue(Value value) {
2496 auto result = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(value);
2497 if (!result)
2498 return result;
2499
2500 // If we got an inout value, implicitly read it. FIRRTL allows direct use
2501 // of wires and other things that lower to inout type.
2502 if (isa<hw::InOutType>(result.getType()))
2503 return getReadValue(result);
2504
2505 return result;
2506}
2507
2508/// Return the lowered value, converting `seq.clock` to `i1.
2509Value FIRRTLLowering::getLoweredNonClockValue(Value value) {
2510 auto result = getLoweredValue(value);
2511 if (!result)
2512 return result;
2513
2514 if (hw::type_isa<seq::ClockType>(result.getType()))
2515 return getNonClockValue(result);
2516
2517 return result;
2518}
2519
2520/// Return the lowered aggregate value whose type is converted into
2521/// `destType`. We have to care about the extension/truncation/signedness of
2522/// each element.
2523Value FIRRTLLowering::getExtOrTruncAggregateValue(Value array,
2524 FIRRTLBaseType sourceType,
2525 FIRRTLBaseType destType,
2526 bool allowTruncate) {
2527 SmallVector<Value> resultBuffer;
2528
2529 // Helper function to cast each element of array to dest type.
2530 auto cast = [&](Value value, FIRRTLBaseType sourceType,
2531 FIRRTLBaseType destType) {
2532 auto srcWidth = firrtl::type_cast<IntType>(sourceType).getWidthOrSentinel();
2533 auto destWidth = firrtl::type_cast<IntType>(destType).getWidthOrSentinel();
2534 auto resultType = builder.getIntegerType(destWidth);
2535
2536 if (srcWidth == destWidth)
2537 return value;
2538
2539 if (srcWidth > destWidth) {
2540 if (allowTruncate)
2541 return builder.createOrFold<comb::ExtractOp>(resultType, value, 0);
2542
2543 builder.emitError("operand should not be a truncation");
2544 return Value();
2545 }
2546
2547 if (firrtl::type_cast<IntType>(sourceType).isSigned())
2548 return comb::createOrFoldSExt(builder, value, resultType);
2549 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(destWidth - srcWidth, 0);
2550 return builder.createOrFold<comb::ConcatOp>(zero, value);
2551 };
2552
2553 // This recursive function constructs the output array.
2554 std::function<LogicalResult(Value, FIRRTLBaseType, FIRRTLBaseType)> recurse =
2555 [&](Value src, FIRRTLBaseType srcType,
2556 FIRRTLBaseType destType) -> LogicalResult {
2557 return TypeSwitch<FIRRTLBaseType, LogicalResult>(srcType)
2558 .Case<FVectorType>([&](auto srcVectorType) {
2559 auto destVectorType = firrtl::type_cast<FVectorType>(destType);
2560 unsigned size = resultBuffer.size();
2561 unsigned indexWidth =
2562 getBitWidthFromVectorSize(srcVectorType.getNumElements());
2563 for (size_t i = 0, e = std::min(srcVectorType.getNumElements(),
2564 destVectorType.getNumElements());
2565 i != e; ++i) {
2566 auto iIdx = getOrCreateIntConstant(indexWidth, i);
2567 auto arrayIndex = hw::ArrayGetOp::create(builder, src, iIdx);
2568 if (failed(recurse(arrayIndex, srcVectorType.getElementType(),
2569 destVectorType.getElementType())))
2570 return failure();
2571 }
2572 SmallVector<Value> temp(resultBuffer.begin() + size,
2573 resultBuffer.end());
2574 auto array = builder.createOrFold<hw::ArrayCreateOp>(temp);
2575 resultBuffer.resize(size);
2576 resultBuffer.push_back(array);
2577 return success();
2578 })
2579 .Case<BundleType>([&](BundleType srcStructType) {
2580 auto destStructType = firrtl::type_cast<BundleType>(destType);
2581 unsigned size = resultBuffer.size();
2582
2583 // TODO: We don't support partial connects for bundles for now.
2584 if (destStructType.getNumElements() != srcStructType.getNumElements())
2585 return failure();
2586
2587 for (auto elem : llvm::enumerate(destStructType)) {
2588 auto structExtract =
2589 hw::StructExtractOp::create(builder, src, elem.value().name);
2590 if (failed(recurse(structExtract,
2591 srcStructType.getElementType(elem.index()),
2592 destStructType.getElementType(elem.index()))))
2593 return failure();
2594 }
2595 SmallVector<Value> temp(resultBuffer.begin() + size,
2596 resultBuffer.end());
2597 auto newStruct = builder.createOrFold<hw::StructCreateOp>(
2598 lowerType(destStructType), temp);
2599 resultBuffer.resize(size);
2600 resultBuffer.push_back(newStruct);
2601 return success();
2602 })
2603 .Case<IntType>([&](auto) {
2604 if (auto result = cast(src, srcType, destType)) {
2605 resultBuffer.push_back(result);
2606 return success();
2607 }
2608 return failure();
2609 })
2610 .Default([&](auto) { return failure(); });
2611 };
2612
2613 if (failed(recurse(array, sourceType, destType)))
2614 return Value();
2615
2616 assert(resultBuffer.size() == 1 &&
2617 "resultBuffer must only contain a result array if `success` is true");
2618 return resultBuffer[0];
2619}
2620
2621/// Return the lowered value corresponding to the specified original value and
2622/// then extend it to match the width of destType if needed.
2623///
2624/// This returns a null value for FIRRTL values that cannot be lowered, e.g.
2625/// unknown width integers.
2626Value FIRRTLLowering::getLoweredAndExtendedValue(Value src, Type target) {
2627 auto srcType = cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(src.getType());
2628 auto dstType = cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(target);
2629 auto loweredSrc = getLoweredValue(src);
2630
2631 // We only know how to extend integer types with known width.
2632 auto dstWidth = dstType.getBitWidthOrSentinel();
2633 if (dstWidth == -1)
2634 return {};
2635
2636 // Handle zero width FIRRTL values which have been removed.
2637 if (!loweredSrc) {
2638 // If this was a zero bit operand being extended, then produce a zero of
2639 // the right result type. If it is just a failure, fail.
2640 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(src.getType()))
2641 return {};
2642 // Zero bit results have to be returned as null. The caller can handle
2643 // this if they want to.
2644 if (dstWidth == 0)
2645 return {};
2646 // Otherwise, FIRRTL semantics is that an extension from a zero bit value
2647 // always produces a zero value in the destination width.
2648 return getOrCreateIntConstant(dstWidth, 0);
2649 }
2650
2651 auto loweredSrcType = loweredSrc.getType();
2652 auto loweredDstType = lowerType(dstType);
2653
2654 // If the two types are the same we do not have to extend.
2655 if (loweredSrcType == loweredDstType)
2656 return loweredSrc;
2657
2658 // Handle type aliases.
2659 if (dstWidth == srcType.getBitWidthOrSentinel()) {
2660 // Lookup the lowered type of dest.
2661 if (loweredSrcType != loweredDstType &&
2662 (isa<hw::TypeAliasType>(loweredSrcType) ||
2663 isa<hw::TypeAliasType>(loweredDstType))) {
2664 return builder.createOrFold<hw::BitcastOp>(loweredDstType, loweredSrc);
2665 }
2666 }
2667
2668 // Aggregates values.
2669 if (isa<hw::ArrayType, hw::StructType>(loweredSrcType))
2670 return getExtOrTruncAggregateValue(loweredSrc, srcType, dstType,
2671 /* allowTruncate */ false);
2672
2673 if (isa<seq::ClockType>(loweredSrcType)) {
2674 builder.emitError("cannot use clock type as an integer");
2675 return {};
2676 }
2677
2678 auto intSourceType = dyn_cast<IntegerType>(loweredSrcType);
2679 if (!intSourceType) {
2680 builder.emitError("operand of type ")
2681 << loweredSrcType << " cannot be used as an integer";
2682 return {};
2683 }
2684
2685 auto loweredSrcWidth = intSourceType.getWidth();
2686 if (loweredSrcWidth == unsigned(dstWidth))
2687 return loweredSrc;
2688
2689 if (loweredSrcWidth > unsigned(dstWidth)) {
2690 builder.emitError("operand should not be a truncation");
2691 return {};
2692 }
2693
2694 // Extension follows the sign of the src value, not the destination.
2695 auto valueFIRType = type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(src.getType()).getPassiveType();
2696 if (type_cast<IntType>(valueFIRType).isSigned())
2697 return comb::createOrFoldSExt(builder, loweredSrc, loweredDstType);
2698
2699 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(dstWidth - loweredSrcWidth, 0);
2700 return builder.createOrFold<comb::ConcatOp>(zero, loweredSrc);
2701}
2702
2703/// Return the lowered value corresponding to the specified original value and
2704/// then extended or truncated to match the width of destType if needed.
2705///
2706/// This returns a null value for FIRRTL values that cannot be lowered, e.g.
2707/// unknown width integers.
2708Value FIRRTLLowering::getLoweredAndExtOrTruncValue(Value value, Type destType) {
2709 assert(type_isa<FIRRTLBaseType>(value.getType()) &&
2710 type_isa<FIRRTLBaseType>(destType) &&
2711 "input/output value should be FIRRTL");
2712
2713 // We only know how to adjust integer types with known width.
2714 auto destWidth = type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(destType).getBitWidthOrSentinel();
2715 if (destWidth == -1)
2716 return {};
2717
2718 auto result = getLoweredValue(value);
2719 if (!result) {
2720 // If this was a zero bit operand being extended, then produce a zero of
2721 // the right result type. If it is just a failure, fail.
2722 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(value.getType()))
2723 return {};
2724 // Zero bit results have to be returned as null. The caller can handle
2725 // this if they want to.
2726 if (destWidth == 0)
2727 return {};
2728 // Otherwise, FIRRTL semantics is that an extension from a zero bit value
2729 // always produces a zero value in the destination width.
2730 return getOrCreateIntConstant(destWidth, 0);
2731 }
2732
2733 // Aggregates values
2734 if (isa<hw::ArrayType, hw::StructType>(result.getType())) {
2735 // Types already match.
2736 if (destType == value.getType())
2737 return result;
2738
2739 return getExtOrTruncAggregateValue(
2740 result, type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(value.getType()),
2741 type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(destType),
2742 /* allowTruncate */ true);
2743 }
2744
2745 auto srcWidth = type_cast<IntegerType>(result.getType()).getWidth();
2746 if (srcWidth == unsigned(destWidth))
2747 return result;
2748
2749 if (destWidth == 0)
2750 return {};
2751
2752 if (srcWidth > unsigned(destWidth)) {
2753 auto resultType = builder.getIntegerType(destWidth);
2754 return builder.createOrFold<comb::ExtractOp>(resultType, result, 0);
2755 }
2756
2757 auto resultType = builder.getIntegerType(destWidth);
2758
2759 // Extension follows the sign of the source value, not the destination.
2760 auto valueFIRType =
2761 type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(value.getType()).getPassiveType();
2762 if (type_cast<IntType>(valueFIRType).isSigned())
2763 return comb::createOrFoldSExt(builder, result, resultType);
2764
2765 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(destWidth - srcWidth, 0);
2766 return builder.createOrFold<comb::ConcatOp>(zero, result);
2767}
2768
2769/// Return a lowered version of 'operand' suitable for use with substitution /
2770/// format strings. There are three possible results:
2771///
2772/// 1. Does not contain a value if no lowering is set. This is an error.
2773/// 2. The lowering contains an empty value. This means that the operand
2774/// should be dropped.
2775/// 3. The lowering contains a value. This means the operand should be used.
2776///
2777/// Zero bit operands are rewritten as one bit zeros and signed integers are
2778/// wrapped in $signed().
2779std::optional<Value> FIRRTLLowering::getLoweredFmtOperand(Value operand) {
2780 // Handle special substitutions.
2781 if (type_isa<FStringType>(operand.getType())) {
2782 if (isa<TimeOp>(operand.getDefiningOp()))
2783 return sv::TimeOp::create(builder);
2784 if (isa<HierarchicalModuleNameOp>(operand.getDefiningOp()))
2785 return {nullptr};
2786 }
2787
2788 auto loweredValue = getLoweredValue(operand);
2789 if (!loweredValue) {
2790 // If this is a zero bit operand, just pass a one bit zero.
2791 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(operand.getType()))
2792 return {};
2793 loweredValue = getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0);
2794 }
2795
2796 // If the operand was an SInt, we want to give the user the option to print
2797 // it as signed decimal and have to wrap it in $signed().
2798 if (auto intTy = firrtl::type_cast<IntType>(operand.getType()))
2799 if (intTy.isSigned())
2800 loweredValue = sv::SystemFunctionOp::create(
2801 builder, loweredValue.getType(), "signed", loweredValue);
2802
2803 return loweredValue;
2804}
2805
2806LogicalResult
2807FIRRTLLowering::loweredFmtOperands(mlir::ValueRange operands,
2808 SmallVectorImpl<Value> &loweredOperands) {
2809 for (auto operand : operands) {
2810 std::optional<Value> loweredValue = getLoweredFmtOperand(operand);
2811 if (!loweredValue)
2812 return failure();
2813 // Skip if the lowered value is null.
2814 if (*loweredValue)
2815 loweredOperands.push_back(*loweredValue);
2816 }
2817 return success();
2818}
2819
2820FailureOr<Value>
2821FIRRTLLowering::lowerSimFormatString(StringRef originalFormatString,
2822 ValueRange operands) {
2823 SmallVector<Value> fragments;
2824
2825 auto emitLiteral = [&](StringRef text) {
2826 if (!text.empty())
2827 fragments.push_back(sim::FormatLiteralOp::create(builder, text));
2828 };
2829
2830 auto emitIntFormat = [&](Value operand, char specifier,
2831 IntegerAttr widthAttr) -> FailureOr<Value> {
2832 Value loweredValue;
2833 if (type_isa<ClockType>(operand.getType()))
2834 loweredValue = getLoweredNonClockValue(operand);
2835 else
2836 loweredValue = getLoweredValue(operand);
2837 if (!loweredValue) {
2838 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(operand.getType()))
2839 return failure();
2840 loweredValue = getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0);
2841 }
2842
2843 if (!mlir::isa<IntegerType>(loweredValue.getType())) {
2844 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "lower-to-core requires integer printf "
2845 "operands for '%")
2846 << specifier << "'";
2847 return failure();
2848 }
2849
2850 switch (specifier) {
2851 case 'b':
2852 return sim::FormatBinOp::create(builder, loweredValue,
2853 builder.getBoolAttr(false),
2854 builder.getI8IntegerAttr('0'), widthAttr)
2855 .getResult();
2856 case 'd': {
2857 UnitAttr signedAttr;
2858 if (auto intTy = dyn_cast<IntType>(operand.getType());
2859 intTy && intTy.isSigned())
2860 signedAttr = builder.getUnitAttr();
2861 return sim::FormatDecOp::create(
2862 builder, loweredValue, builder.getBoolAttr(false),
2863 builder.getI8IntegerAttr(' '), widthAttr, signedAttr)
2864 .getResult();
2865 }
2866 case 'x':
2867 return sim::FormatHexOp::create(builder, loweredValue,
2868 builder.getBoolAttr(false),
2869 builder.getBoolAttr(false),
2870 builder.getI8IntegerAttr('0'), widthAttr)
2871 .getResult();
2872 case 'c':
2873 return sim::FormatCharOp::create(builder, loweredValue).getResult();
2874 default:
2875 llvm_unreachable("unsupported FIRRTL format specifier");
2876 }
2877 };
2878
2879 SmallString<32> literal;
2880 for (size_t i = 0, e = originalFormatString.size(), subIdx = 0; i != e; ++i) {
2881 char c = originalFormatString[i];
2882 switch (c) {
2883 case '%': {
2884 emitLiteral(literal);
2885 literal.clear();
2886
2887 SmallString<6> width;
2888 c = originalFormatString[++i];
2889 while (isdigit(c)) {
2890 width.push_back(c);
2891 c = originalFormatString[++i];
2892 }
2893
2894 IntegerAttr widthAttr;
2895 if (!width.empty()) {
2896 unsigned widthValue;
2897 if (StringRef(width).getAsInteger(10, widthValue)) {
2898 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "invalid FIRRTL printf width");
2899 return failure();
2900 }
2901 widthAttr = builder.getI32IntegerAttr(widthValue);
2902 }
2903
2904 if (c == '%') {
2905 if (!width.empty()) {
2906 emitError(builder.getLoc(),
2907 "literal percents ('%%') may not specify a width");
2908 return failure();
2909 }
2910 literal.push_back('%');
2911 break;
2912 }
2913
2914 if (operands.size() <= subIdx) {
2915 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "not enough operands for printf format");
2916 return failure();
2917 }
2918
2919 if (c == 'c' && widthAttr) {
2920 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "ASCII character format specifiers ('%c') "
2921 "may not specify a width");
2922 return failure();
2923 }
2924
2925 switch (c) {
2926 case 'b':
2927 case 'd':
2928 case 'x':
2929 case 'c': {
2930 auto fragment = emitIntFormat(operands[subIdx++], c, widthAttr);
2931 if (failed(fragment))
2932 return failure();
2933 fragments.push_back(*fragment);
2934 break;
2935 }
2936 default:
2937 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "unknown printf substitution '%")
2938 << width << c << "'";
2939 return failure();
2940 }
2941 break;
2942 }
2943 case '{': {
2944 if (originalFormatString.slice(i, i + 4) != "{{}}") {
2945 literal.push_back(c);
2946 break;
2947 }
2948
2949 emitLiteral(literal);
2950 literal.clear();
2951
2952 if (operands.size() <= subIdx) {
2953 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "not enough operands for printf format");
2954 return failure();
2955 }
2956
2957 auto substitution = operands[subIdx++];
2958 if (!type_isa<FStringType>(substitution.getType())) {
2959 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "expected fstring operand for '{{}}' "
2960 "substitution");
2961 return failure();
2962 }
2963
2964 auto result =
2965 TypeSwitch<Operation *, LogicalResult>(substitution.getDefiningOp())
2966 .template Case<HierarchicalModuleNameOp>([&](auto) {
2967 fragments.push_back(sim::FormatHierPathOp::create(
2968 builder, /*useEscapes=*/false));
2969 return success();
2970 })
2971 .template Case<TimeOp>([&](auto) {
2972 fragments.push_back(sim::FormatCurrentTimeOp::create(builder));
2973 return success();
2974 })
2975 .Default([&](auto) {
2976 emitError(builder.getLoc(), "has a substitution with "
2977 "an unimplemented "
2978 "lowering")
2979 .attachNote(substitution.getLoc())
2980 << "op with an unimplemented lowering is here";
2981 return failure();
2982 });
2983 if (failed(result))
2984 return failure();
2985 i += 3;
2986 break;
2987 }
2988 default:
2989 literal.push_back(c);
2990 break;
2991 }
2992 }
2993
2994 emitLiteral(literal);
2995 if (fragments.empty())
2996 return sim::FormatLiteralOp::create(builder, "").getResult();
2997 if (fragments.size() == 1)
2998 return fragments.front();
2999 return sim::FormatStringConcatOp::create(builder, fragments).getResult();
3000}
3001
3002LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerStatementWithFd(
3003 const FileDescriptorInfo &fileDescriptor, Value clock, Value cond,
3004 const std::function<LogicalResult(Value)> &fn, bool usePrintfCond) {
3005 // Emit an "#ifndef SYNTHESIS" guard into the always block.
3006 bool failed = false;
3007 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
3008 addToIfDefBlock("SYNTHESIS", std::function<void()>(), [&]() {
3009 addToAlwaysBlock(clock, [&]() {
3010 // TODO: This is not printf specific anymore. Replace "Printf" with "FD"
3011 // or similar but be aware that changing macro name breaks existing uses.
3012 circuitState.usedPrintf = true;
3013 if (usePrintfCond)
3014 circuitState.addFragment(theModule, "PRINTF_COND_FRAGMENT");
3015
3016 // Emit an "sv.if '`PRINTF_COND_ & cond' into the #ifndef.
3017 Value ifCond = cond;
3018 if (usePrintfCond) {
3019 ifCond =
3020 sv::MacroRefExprOp::create(builder, cond.getType(), "PRINTF_COND_");
3021 ifCond = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(ifCond, cond, true);
3022 }
3023
3024 addIfProceduralBlock(ifCond, [&]() {
3025 // `fd`represents a file decriptor. Use the stdout or the one opened
3026 // using $fopen.
3027 Value fd;
3028 if (fileDescriptor.isDefaultFd()) {
3029 // Emit the sv.fwrite, writing to stderr by default.
3030 fd = hw::ConstantOp::create(builder, APInt(32, 0x80000002));
3031 } else {
3032 // Call the library function to get the FD.
3033 auto fdOrError = callFileDescriptorLib(fileDescriptor);
3034 if (llvm::failed(fdOrError)) {
3035 failed = true;
3036 return;
3037 }
3038 fd = *fdOrError;
3039 }
3040 failed = llvm::failed(fn(fd));
3041 });
3042 });
3043 });
3044 return failure(failed);
3045}
3046
3047FailureOr<Value>
3048FIRRTLLowering::callFileDescriptorLib(const FileDescriptorInfo &info) {
3049 circuitState.usedFileDescriptorLib = true;
3050 circuitState.addFragment(
3051 theModule, sv::getFileDescriptorFragmentRef(builder.getContext()));
3052
3053 Value fileName;
3054 if (info.isSubstitutionRequired()) {
3055 SmallVector<Value> fileNameOperands;
3056 if (failed(loweredFmtOperands(info.getSubstitutions(), fileNameOperands)))
3057 return failure();
3058
3059 fileName = sv::SFormatFOp::create(builder, info.getOutputFileFormat(),
3060 fileNameOperands)
3061 .getResult();
3062 } else {
3063 // If substitution is not required, just use the output file name.
3064 fileName = sv::ConstantStrOp::create(builder, info.getOutputFileFormat())
3065 .getResult();
3066 }
3067
3068 return sv::createProceduralFileDescriptorGetterCall(builder, builder.getLoc(),
3069 fileName);
3070}
3071
3072/// Set the lowered value of 'orig' to 'result', remembering this in a map.
3073/// This always returns success() to make it more convenient in lowering code.
3074///
3075/// Note that result may be null here if we're lowering orig to a zero-bit
3076/// value.
3077///
3078LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::setLowering(Value orig, Value result) {
3079 if (auto origType = dyn_cast<FIRRTLType>(orig.getType())) {
3080 assert((!result || !type_isa<FIRRTLType>(result.getType())) &&
3081 "Lowering didn't turn a FIRRTL value into a non-FIRRTL value");
3082
3083#ifndef NDEBUG
3084 auto baseType = getBaseType(origType);
3085 auto srcWidth = baseType.getPassiveType().getBitWidthOrSentinel();
3086
3087 // Caller should pass null value iff this was a zero bit value.
3088 if (srcWidth != -1) {
3089 if (result)
3090 assert((srcWidth != 0) &&
3091 "Lowering produced value for zero width source");
3092 else
3093 assert((srcWidth == 0) &&
3094 "Lowering produced null value but source wasn't zero width");
3095 }
3096#endif
3097 } else {
3098 assert(result && "Lowering of foreign type produced null value");
3099 }
3100
3101 auto &slot = valueMapping[orig];
3102 assert(!slot && "value lowered multiple times");
3103 slot = result;
3104 return success();
3105}
3106
3107/// Set the lowering for a value to the specified result. This came from a
3108/// possible folding, so check to see if we need to handle a constant.
3109LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::setPossiblyFoldedLowering(Value orig,
3110 Value result) {
3111 // If this is a constant, check to see if we have it in our unique mapping:
3112 // it could have come from folding an operation.
3113 if (auto cst = dyn_cast_or_null<hw::ConstantOp>(result.getDefiningOp())) {
3114 auto &entry = hwConstantMap[cst.getValueAttr()];
3115 if (entry == cst) {
3116 // We're already using an entry in the constant map, nothing to do.
3117 } else if (entry) {
3118 // We already had this constant, reuse the one we have instead of the
3119 // one we just folded.
3120 result = entry;
3121 cst->erase();
3122 } else {
3123 // This is a new constant. Remember it!
3124 entry = cst;
3125 cst->moveBefore(&theModule.getBodyBlock()->front());
3126 }
3127 }
3128
3129 return setLowering(orig, result);
3130}
3131
3132/// Create a new operation with type ResultOpType and arguments CtorArgTypes,
3133/// then call setLowering with its result.
3134template <typename ResultOpType, typename... CtorArgTypes>
3135LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::setLoweringTo(Operation *orig,
3136 CtorArgTypes... args) {
3137 auto result = builder.createOrFold<ResultOpType>(args...);
3138 if (auto *op = result.getDefiningOp())
3139 tryCopyName(op, orig);
3140 return setPossiblyFoldedLowering(orig->getResult(0), result);
3141}
3142
3143/// Create a new LTL operation with type ResultOpType and arguments
3144/// CtorArgTypes, then call setLowering with its result. Also add the operation
3145/// to the worklist of LTL ops that need to have their types fixed-up after the
3146/// lowering.
3147template <typename ResultOpType, typename... CtorArgTypes>
3148LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::setLoweringToLTL(Operation *orig,
3149 CtorArgTypes... args) {
3150 auto result = builder.createOrFold<ResultOpType>(args...);
3151 if (auto *op = result.getDefiningOp())
3152 ltlOpFixupWorklist.insert(op);
3153 return setPossiblyFoldedLowering(orig->getResult(0), result);
3154}
3155
3156/// Creates a backedge of the specified result type. A backedge represents a
3157/// placeholder to be filled in later by a lowered value. If the backedge is not
3158/// updated with a real value by the end of the pass, it will be replaced with
3159/// an undriven wire. Backedges are allowed to be updated to other backedges.
3160/// If a chain of backedges forms a combinational loop, they will be replaced
3161/// with an undriven wire.
3162Backedge FIRRTLLowering::createBackedge(Location loc, Type type) {
3163 auto backedge = backedgeBuilder.get(type, loc);
3164 backedges.insert({backedge, backedge});
3165 return backedge;
3166}
3167
3168/// Sets the lowering for a value to a backedge of the specified result type.
3169/// This is useful for lowering types which cannot pass through a wire, or to
3170/// directly materialize values in operations that violate the SSA dominance
3171/// constraint.
3172Backedge FIRRTLLowering::createBackedge(Value orig, Type type) {
3173 auto backedge = createBackedge(orig.getLoc(), type);
3174 (void)setLowering(orig, backedge);
3175 return backedge;
3176}
3177
3178/// If the `from` value is in fact a backedge, record that the backedge will
3179/// be replaced by the value. Return true if the destination is a backedge.
3180bool FIRRTLLowering::updateIfBackedge(Value dest, Value src) {
3181 auto backedgeIt = backedges.find(dest);
3182 if (backedgeIt == backedges.end())
3183 return false;
3184 backedgeIt->second = src;
3185 return true;
3186}
3187
3188/// Switch the insertion point of the current builder to the end of the
3189/// specified block and run the closure. This correctly handles the case
3190/// where the closure is null, but the caller needs to make sure the block
3191/// exists.
3192void FIRRTLLowering::runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(
3193 const std::function<void(void)> &fn, Region &region) {
3194 if (!fn)
3195 return;
3196
3197 auto oldIP = builder.saveInsertionPoint();
3198
3199 builder.setInsertionPointToEnd(&region.front());
3200 fn();
3201 builder.restoreInsertionPoint(oldIP);
3202}
3203
3204/// Return a read value for the specified inout operation, auto-uniquing them.
3205Value FIRRTLLowering::getReadValue(Value v) {
3206 Value result = readInOutCreated.lookup(v);
3207 if (result)
3208 return result;
3209
3210 // Make sure to put the read value at the correct scope so it dominates all
3211 // future uses.
3212 auto oldIP = builder.saveInsertionPoint();
3213 if (auto *vOp = v.getDefiningOp()) {
3214 builder.setInsertionPointAfter(vOp);
3215 } else {
3216 // For reads of ports, just set the insertion point at the top of the
3217 // module.
3218 builder.setInsertionPoint(&theModule.getBodyBlock()->front());
3219 }
3220
3221 // Instead of creating `ReadInOutOp` for `ArrayIndexInOutOp`, create
3222 // `ArrayGetOp` for root arrays.
3223 if (auto arrayIndexInout = v.getDefiningOp<sv::ArrayIndexInOutOp>()) {
3224 result = getReadValue(arrayIndexInout.getInput());
3225 result = builder.createOrFold<hw::ArrayGetOp>(result,
3226 arrayIndexInout.getIndex());
3227 } else {
3228 // Otherwise, create a read inout operation.
3229 result = builder.createOrFold<sv::ReadInOutOp>(v);
3230 }
3231 builder.restoreInsertionPoint(oldIP);
3232 readInOutCreated.insert({v, result});
3233 return result;
3234}
3235
3236Value FIRRTLLowering::getNonClockValue(Value v) {
3237 auto it = fromClockMapping.try_emplace(v, Value{});
3238 if (it.second) {
3239 ImplicitLocOpBuilder builder(v.getLoc(), v.getContext());
3240 builder.setInsertionPointAfterValue(v);
3241 it.first->second = seq::FromClockOp::create(builder, v);
3242 }
3243 return it.first->second;
3244}
3245
3246void FIRRTLLowering::addToAlwaysBlock(
3247 sv::EventControl clockEdge, Value clock, sv::ResetType resetStyle,
3248 sv::EventControl resetEdge, Value reset,
3249 const std::function<void(void)> &body,
3250 const std::function<void(void)> &resetBody) {
3251 AlwaysKeyType key{builder.getBlock(), clockEdge, clock,
3252 resetStyle, resetEdge, reset};
3253 sv::AlwaysOp alwaysOp;
3254 sv::IfOp insideIfOp;
3255 std::tie(alwaysOp, insideIfOp) = alwaysBlocks.lookup(key);
3256
3257 if (!alwaysOp) {
3258 if (reset) {
3259 assert(resetStyle != sv::ResetType::NoReset);
3260 // Here, we want to create the folloing structure with sv.always and
3261 // sv.if. If `reset` is async, we need to add `reset` to a sensitivity
3262 // list.
3263 //
3264 // sv.always @(clockEdge or reset) {
3265 // sv.if (reset) {
3266 // resetBody
3267 // } else {
3268 // body
3269 // }
3270 // }
3271
3272 auto createIfOp = [&]() {
3273 // It is weird but intended. Here we want to create an empty sv.if
3274 // with an else block.
3275 insideIfOp = sv::IfOp::create(
3276 builder, reset, [] {}, [] {});
3277 };
3278 if (resetStyle == sv::ResetType::AsyncReset) {
3279 sv::EventControl events[] = {clockEdge, resetEdge};
3280 Value clocks[] = {clock, reset};
3281
3282 alwaysOp = sv::AlwaysOp::create(builder, events, clocks, [&]() {
3283 if (resetEdge == sv::EventControl::AtNegEdge)
3284 llvm_unreachable("negative edge for reset is not expected");
3285 createIfOp();
3286 });
3287 } else {
3288 alwaysOp = sv::AlwaysOp::create(builder, clockEdge, clock, createIfOp);
3289 }
3290 } else {
3291 assert(!resetBody);
3292 alwaysOp = sv::AlwaysOp::create(builder, clockEdge, clock);
3293 insideIfOp = nullptr;
3294 }
3295 alwaysBlocks[key] = {alwaysOp, insideIfOp};
3296 }
3297
3298 if (reset) {
3299 assert(insideIfOp && "reset body must be initialized before");
3300 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(resetBody, insideIfOp.getThenRegion());
3301 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(body, insideIfOp.getElseRegion());
3302 } else {
3303 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(body, alwaysOp.getBody());
3304 }
3305
3306 // Move the earlier always block(s) down to where the last would have been
3307 // inserted. This ensures that any values used by the always blocks are
3308 // defined ahead of the uses, which leads to better generated Verilog.
3309 alwaysOp->moveBefore(builder.getInsertionBlock(),
3310 builder.getInsertionPoint());
3311}
3312
3313LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::emitGuards(Location loc,
3314 ArrayRef<Attribute> guards,
3315 std::function<void(void)> emit) {
3316 if (guards.empty()) {
3317 emit();
3318 return success();
3319 }
3320 auto guard = dyn_cast<StringAttr>(guards[0]);
3321 if (!guard)
3322 return mlir::emitError(loc,
3323 "elements in `guards` array must be `StringAttr`");
3324
3325 // Record the guard macro to emit a declaration for it.
3326 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr(guard.getValue()));
3327 LogicalResult result = LogicalResult::failure();
3328 addToIfDefBlock(guard.getValue(), [&]() {
3329 result = emitGuards(loc, guards.drop_front(), emit);
3330 });
3331 return result;
3332}
3333
3334void FIRRTLLowering::addToIfDefBlock(StringRef cond,
3335 std::function<void(void)> thenCtor,
3336 std::function<void(void)> elseCtor) {
3337 auto condAttr = builder.getStringAttr(cond);
3338 auto op = ifdefBlocks.lookup({builder.getBlock(), condAttr});
3339 if (op) {
3340 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(thenCtor, op.getThenRegion());
3341 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(elseCtor, op.getElseRegion());
3342
3343 // Move the earlier #ifdef block(s) down to where the last would have been
3344 // inserted. This ensures that any values used by the #ifdef blocks are
3345 // defined ahead of the uses, which leads to better generated Verilog.
3346 op->moveBefore(builder.getInsertionBlock(), builder.getInsertionPoint());
3347 } else {
3348 ifdefBlocks[{builder.getBlock(), condAttr}] =
3349 sv::IfDefOp::create(builder, condAttr, thenCtor, elseCtor);
3350 }
3351}
3352
3353void FIRRTLLowering::addToInitialBlock(std::function<void(void)> body) {
3354 auto op = initialBlocks.lookup(builder.getBlock());
3355 if (op) {
3356 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(body, op.getBody());
3357
3358 // Move the earlier initial block(s) down to where the last would have
3359 // been inserted. This ensures that any values used by the initial blocks
3360 // are defined ahead of the uses, which leads to better generated Verilog.
3361 op->moveBefore(builder.getInsertionBlock(), builder.getInsertionPoint());
3362 } else {
3363 initialBlocks[builder.getBlock()] = sv::InitialOp::create(builder, body);
3364 }
3365}
3366
3367void FIRRTLLowering::addIfProceduralBlock(Value cond,
3368 std::function<void(void)> thenCtor,
3369 std::function<void(void)> elseCtor) {
3370 // Check to see if we already have an if on this condition immediately
3371 // before the insertion point. If so, extend it.
3372 auto insertIt = builder.getInsertionPoint();
3373 if (insertIt != builder.getBlock()->begin())
3374 if (auto ifOp = dyn_cast<sv::IfOp>(*--insertIt)) {
3375 if (ifOp.getCond() == cond) {
3376 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(thenCtor, ifOp.getThenRegion());
3377 runWithInsertionPointAtEndOfBlock(elseCtor, ifOp.getElseRegion());
3378 return;
3379 }
3380 }
3381
3382 sv::IfOp::create(builder, cond, thenCtor, elseCtor);
3383}
3384
3385//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
3386// Special Operations
3387//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
3388
3389/// Handle the case where an operation wasn't lowered. When this happens, the
3390/// operands should just be unlowered non-FIRRTL values. If the operand was
3391/// not lowered then leave it alone, otherwise we have a problem with
3392/// lowering.
3393///
3394FIRRTLLowering::UnloweredOpResult
3395FIRRTLLowering::handleUnloweredOp(Operation *op) {
3396 // FIRRTL operations must explicitly handle their regions.
3397 if (!op->getRegions().empty() &&
3398 isa_and_nonnull<FIRRTLDialect>(op->getDialect())) {
3399 op->emitOpError("must explicitly handle its regions");
3400 return LoweringFailure;
3401 }
3402
3403 // Simply pass through non-FIRRTL operations and consider them already
3404 // lowered. This allows us to handled partially lowered inputs, and also allow
3405 // other FIRRTL operations to spawn additional already-lowered operations,
3406 // like `hw.output`.
3407 if (!isa_and_nonnull<FIRRTLDialect>(op->getDialect())) {
3408 // Push nested operations onto the worklist such that they are lowered.
3409 for (auto &region : op->getRegions())
3410 addToWorklist(region);
3411 for (auto &operand : op->getOpOperands())
3412 if (auto lowered = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(operand.get()))
3413 operand.set(lowered);
3414 for (auto result : op->getResults())
3415 (void)setLowering(result, result);
3416 return AlreadyLowered;
3417 }
3418
3419 // Ok, at least one operand got lowered, so this operation is using a FIRRTL
3420 // value, but wasn't itself lowered. This is because the lowering is
3421 // incomplete. This is either a bug or incomplete implementation.
3422 //
3423 // There is one aspect of incompleteness we intentionally expect: we allow
3424 // primitive operations that produce a zero bit result to be ignored by the
3425 // lowering logic. They don't have side effects, and handling this corner
3426 // case just complicates each of the lowering hooks. Instead, we just handle
3427 // them all right here.
3428 if (op->getNumResults() == 1) {
3429 auto resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
3430 if (type_isa<FIRRTLBaseType>(resultType) &&
3431 isZeroBitFIRRTLType(resultType) &&
3432 (isExpression(op) || isa<mlir::UnrealizedConversionCastOp>(op))) {
3433 // Zero bit values lower to the null Value.
3434 (void)setLowering(op->getResult(0), Value());
3435 return NowLowered;
3436 }
3437 }
3438 op->emitOpError("LowerToHW couldn't handle this operation");
3439 return LoweringFailure;
3440}
3441
3442LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(ConstantOp op) {
3443 // Zero width values must be lowered to nothing.
3444 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3445 return setLowering(op, Value());
3446
3447 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(op.getValue()));
3448}
3449
3450LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(SpecialConstantOp op) {
3451 Value cst;
3452 if (isa<ClockType>(op.getType())) {
3453 cst = getOrCreateClockConstant(op.getValue() ? seq::ClockConst::High
3454 : seq::ClockConst::Low);
3455 } else {
3456 cst = getOrCreateIntConstant(APInt(/*bitWidth*/ 1, op.getValue()));
3457 }
3458 return setLowering(op, cst);
3459}
3460
3461FailureOr<Value> FIRRTLLowering::lowerSubindex(SubindexOp op, Value input) {
3462 auto iIdx = getOrCreateIntConstant(
3463 getBitWidthFromVectorSize(
3464 firrtl::type_cast<FVectorType>(op.getInput().getType())
3465 .getNumElements()),
3466 op.getIndex());
3467
3468 // If the input has an inout type, we need to lower to ArrayIndexInOutOp;
3469 // otherwise hw::ArrayGetOp.
3470 Value result;
3471 if (isa<sv::InOutType>(input.getType()))
3472 result = builder.createOrFold<sv::ArrayIndexInOutOp>(input, iIdx);
3473 else
3474 result = builder.createOrFold<hw::ArrayGetOp>(input, iIdx);
3475 if (auto *definingOp = result.getDefiningOp())
3476 tryCopyName(definingOp, op);
3477 return result;
3478}
3479
3480FailureOr<Value> FIRRTLLowering::lowerSubaccess(SubaccessOp op, Value input) {
3481 Value valueIdx = getLoweredAndExtOrTruncValue(
3482 op.getIndex(),
3483 UIntType::get(op->getContext(),
3484 getBitWidthFromVectorSize(
3485 firrtl::type_cast<FVectorType>(op.getInput().getType())
3486 .getNumElements())));
3487 if (!valueIdx) {
3488 op->emitError() << "input lowering failed";
3489 return failure();
3490 }
3491
3492 // If the input has an inout type, we need to lower to ArrayIndexInOutOp;
3493 // otherwise, lower the op to array indexing.
3494 Value result;
3495 if (isa<sv::InOutType>(input.getType()))
3496 result = builder.createOrFold<sv::ArrayIndexInOutOp>(input, valueIdx);
3497 else
3498 result = createArrayIndexing(input, valueIdx);
3499 if (auto *definingOp = result.getDefiningOp())
3500 tryCopyName(definingOp, op);
3501 return result;
3502}
3503
3504FailureOr<Value> FIRRTLLowering::lowerSubfield(SubfieldOp op, Value input) {
3505 auto resultType = lowerType(op->getResult(0).getType());
3506 if (!resultType || !input) {
3507 op->emitError() << "subfield type lowering failed";
3508 return failure();
3509 }
3510
3511 // If the input has an inout type, we need to lower to StructFieldInOutOp;
3512 // otherwise, StructExtractOp.
3513 auto field = firrtl::type_cast<BundleType>(op.getInput().getType())
3514 .getElementName(op.getFieldIndex());
3515 Value result;
3516 if (isa<sv::InOutType>(input.getType()))
3517 result = builder.createOrFold<sv::StructFieldInOutOp>(input, field);
3518 else
3519 result = builder.createOrFold<hw::StructExtractOp>(input, field);
3520 if (auto *definingOp = result.getDefiningOp())
3521 tryCopyName(definingOp, op);
3522 return result;
3523}
3524
3525LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(SubindexOp op) {
3526 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3527 return setLowering(op, Value());
3528
3529 auto input = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3530 if (!input)
3531 return op.emitError() << "input lowering failed";
3532
3533 auto result = lowerSubindex(op, input);
3534 if (failed(result))
3535 return failure();
3536 return setLowering(op, *result);
3537}
3538
3539LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(SubaccessOp op) {
3540 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3541 return setLowering(op, Value());
3542
3543 auto input = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3544 if (!input)
3545 return op.emitError() << "input lowering failed";
3546
3547 auto result = lowerSubaccess(op, input);
3548 if (failed(result))
3549 return failure();
3550 return setLowering(op, *result);
3551}
3552
3553LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(SubfieldOp op) {
3554 // firrtl.mem lowering lowers some SubfieldOps. Zero-width can leave
3555 // invalid subfield accesses
3556 if (getLoweredValue(op) || !op.getInput())
3557 return success();
3558
3559 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3560 return setLowering(op, Value());
3561
3562 auto input = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3563 if (!input)
3564 return op.emitError() << "input lowering failed";
3565
3566 auto result = lowerSubfield(op, input);
3567 if (failed(result))
3568 return failure();
3569 return setLowering(op, *result);
3570}
3571
3572LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(VectorCreateOp op) {
3573 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getResult().getType());
3574 auto arrayType = cast<hw::ArrayType>(resultType);
3575 SmallVector<Value> operands;
3576 // NOTE: The operand order must be inverted.
3577 for (auto oper : llvm::reverse(op.getOperands())) {
3578 auto val = getLoweredValue(oper);
3579 if (!val) {
3580 // Lower zero-bit operands.
3581 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(oper.getType()))
3582 return failure();
3583 val = getZeroValueForType(arrayType.getElementType());
3584 }
3585 operands.push_back(val);
3586 }
3587 return setLoweringTo<hw::ArrayCreateOp>(op, resultType, operands);
3588}
3589
3590LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(BundleCreateOp op) {
3591 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getResult().getType());
3592 auto structType = cast<hw::StructType>(resultType);
3593 SmallVector<Value> operands;
3594 for (auto [oper, field] :
3595 llvm::zip_equal(op.getOperands(), structType.getElements())) {
3596 auto val = getLoweredValue(oper);
3597 if (!val) {
3598 // Lower zero-bit operands.
3599 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(oper.getType()))
3600 return failure();
3601 val = getZeroValueForType(field.type);
3602 }
3603 operands.push_back(val);
3604 }
3605 return setLoweringTo<hw::StructCreateOp>(op, resultType, operands);
3606}
3607
3608LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(FEnumCreateOp op) {
3609 // Zero width values must be lowered to nothing.
3610 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3611 return setLowering(op, Value());
3612
3613 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3614 auto tagName = op.getFieldNameAttr();
3615 auto oldType = op.getType().base();
3616 auto newType = lowerType(oldType);
3617 auto element = *oldType.getElement(op.getFieldNameAttr());
3618
3619 if (auto structType = dyn_cast<hw::StructType>(newType)) {
3620 // If the input is zero-width, getLoweredValue returns a null Value.
3621 // We still need a valid operand for the union body; create an i0 constant.
3622 if (!input) {
3623 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getInput().getType()))
3624 return failure();
3625 input = getOrCreateIntConstant(0, 0);
3626 }
3627 auto tagType = structType.getFieldType("tag");
3628 auto tagValue = IntegerAttr::get(tagType, element.value.getValue());
3629 auto tag = sv::LocalParamOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), tagType, tagValue,
3630 tagName);
3631 auto bodyType = structType.getFieldType("body");
3632 auto body = hw::UnionCreateOp::create(builder, bodyType, tagName, input);
3633 SmallVector<Value> operands = {tag.getResult(), body.getResult()};
3634 return setLoweringTo<hw::StructCreateOp>(op, structType, operands);
3635 }
3636 auto tagValue = IntegerAttr::get(newType, element.value.getValue());
3637 return setLoweringTo<sv::LocalParamOp>(op, newType, tagValue, tagName);
3638}
3639
3640LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(AggregateConstantOp op) {
3641 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getResult().getType());
3642 auto attr =
3643 getOrCreateAggregateConstantAttribute(op.getFieldsAttr(), resultType);
3644
3645 return setLoweringTo<hw::AggregateConstantOp>(op, resultType,
3646 cast<ArrayAttr>(attr));
3647}
3648
3649LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(IsTagOp op) {
3650 // A zero-width enum has exactly one variant, so the tag check is trivially
3651 // true.
3652 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getInput().getType()))
3653 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 1));
3654
3655 auto tagName = op.getFieldNameAttr();
3656 auto lhs = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3657 if (isa<hw::StructType>(lhs.getType()))
3658 lhs = hw::StructExtractOp::create(builder, lhs, "tag");
3659
3660 auto index = op.getFieldIndex();
3661 auto enumType = op.getInput().getType().base();
3662 auto tagValue = enumType.getElementValueAttr(index);
3663 auto tagValueType = IntegerType::get(op.getContext(), enumType.getTagWidth());
3664 auto loweredTagValue = IntegerAttr::get(tagValueType, tagValue.getValue());
3665 auto rhs = sv::LocalParamOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), tagValueType,
3666 loweredTagValue, tagName);
3667
3668 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(1);
3669 return setLoweringTo<comb::ICmpOp>(op, resultType, ICmpPredicate::eq, lhs,
3670 rhs, true);
3671}
3672
3673LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(SubtagOp op) {
3674 // Zero width values must be lowered to nothing.
3675 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3676 return setLowering(op, Value());
3677
3678 auto tagName = op.getFieldNameAttr();
3679 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3680 auto field = hw::StructExtractOp::create(builder, input, "body");
3681 return setLoweringTo<hw::UnionExtractOp>(op, field, tagName);
3682}
3683
3684LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(TagExtractOp op) {
3685 // Zero width values must be lowered to nothing.
3686 if (isZeroBitFIRRTLType(op.getType()))
3687 return setLowering(op, Value());
3688
3689 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3690 if (!input)
3691 return failure();
3692
3693 // If the lowered enum is a struct (has both tag and body), extract the tag
3694 // field.
3695 if (isa<hw::StructType>(input.getType())) {
3696 return setLoweringTo<hw::StructExtractOp>(op, input, "tag");
3697 }
3698
3699 // If the lowered enum is just the tag (simple enum with no data), return it
3700 // directly.
3701 return setLowering(op, input);
3702}
3703
3704//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
3705// Declarations
3706//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
3707
3708LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(WireOp op) {
3709 auto origResultType = op.getResult().getType();
3710
3711 // Foreign types lower to a backedge that needs to be resolved by a later
3712 // connect op.
3713 if (!type_isa<FIRRTLType>(origResultType)) {
3714 createBackedge(op.getResult(), origResultType);
3715 return success();
3716 }
3717
3718 auto resultType = lowerType(origResultType);
3719 if (!resultType)
3720 return failure();
3721
3722 if (resultType.isInteger(0)) {
3723 if (op.getInnerSym())
3724 return op.emitError("zero width wire is referenced by name [")
3725 << *op.getInnerSym() << "] (e.g. in an XMR) but must be removed";
3726 return setLowering(op.getResult(), Value());
3727 }
3728
3729 // Name attr is required on sv.wire but optional on firrtl.wire.
3730 auto innerSym = lowerInnerSymbol(op);
3731 auto name = op.getNameAttr();
3732 // This is not a temporary wire created by the compiler, so attach a symbol
3733 // name.
3734 auto wire = hw::WireOp::create(
3735 builder, op.getLoc(), getOrCreateZConstant(resultType), name, innerSym);
3736
3737 if (auto svAttrs = sv::getSVAttributes(op))
3738 sv::setSVAttributes(wire, svAttrs);
3739
3740 return setLowering(op.getResult(), wire);
3741}
3742
3743LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(VerbatimWireOp op) {
3744 auto resultTy = lowerType(op.getType());
3745 if (!resultTy)
3746 return failure();
3747 resultTy = sv::InOutType::get(op.getContext(), resultTy);
3748
3749 SmallVector<Value, 4> operands;
3750 operands.reserve(op.getSubstitutions().size());
3751 for (auto operand : op.getSubstitutions()) {
3752 auto lowered = getLoweredValue(operand);
3753 if (!lowered)
3754 return failure();
3755 operands.push_back(lowered);
3756 }
3757
3758 ArrayAttr symbols = op.getSymbolsAttr();
3759 if (!symbols)
3760 symbols = ArrayAttr::get(op.getContext(), {});
3761
3762 return setLoweringTo<sv::VerbatimExprSEOp>(op, resultTy, op.getTextAttr(),
3763 operands, symbols);
3764}
3765
3766LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(NodeOp op) {
3767 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
3768 if (!operand)
3769 return handleZeroBit(op.getInput(), [&]() -> LogicalResult {
3770 if (op.getInnerSym())
3771 return op.emitError("zero width node is referenced by name [")
3772 << *op.getInnerSym()
3773 << "] (e.g. in an XMR) but must be "
3774 "removed";
3775 return setLowering(op.getResult(), Value());
3776 });
3777
3778 // Node operations are logical noops, but may carry annotations or be
3779 // referred to through an inner name. If a don't touch is present, ensure
3780 // that we have a symbol name so we can keep the node as a wire.
3781 auto name = op.getNameAttr();
3782 auto innerSym = lowerInnerSymbol(op);
3783
3784 if (innerSym)
3785 operand = hw::WireOp::create(builder, operand, name, innerSym);
3786
3787 // Move SV attributes.
3788 if (auto svAttrs = sv::getSVAttributes(op)) {
3789 if (!innerSym)
3790 operand = hw::WireOp::create(builder, operand, name);
3791 sv::setSVAttributes(operand.getDefiningOp(), svAttrs);
3792 }
3793
3794 return setLowering(op.getResult(), operand);
3795}
3796
3797LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(RegOp op) {
3798 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getResult().getType());
3799 if (!resultType)
3800 return failure();
3801 if (resultType.isInteger(0))
3802 return setLowering(op.getResult(), Value());
3803
3804 Value clockVal = getLoweredValue(op.getClockVal());
3805 if (!clockVal)
3806 return failure();
3807
3808 // Lower an optional `initial` time-zero value into a `seq.firreg` preset.
3809 Attribute presetAttr;
3810 if (auto initial = op.getInitialAttr()) {
3811 auto intTy = dyn_cast<IntegerType>(resultType);
3812 assert(intTy && "'initial' must be integer type");
3813 presetAttr = builder.getIntegerAttr(
3814 intTy, initial.getValue().zextOrTrunc(intTy.getWidth()));
3815 }
3816
3817 // Create a reg op, wiring itself to its input.
3818 auto innerSym = lowerInnerSymbol(op);
3819 Backedge inputEdge = backedgeBuilder.get(resultType);
3820 auto reg = seq::FirRegOp::create(builder, inputEdge, clockVal,
3821 op.getNameAttr(), innerSym, presetAttr);
3822
3823 // Pass along the start and end random initialization bits for this register.
3824 if (auto randomRegister = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_register"))
3825 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_register", randomRegister);
3826 if (auto randomStart = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_start"))
3827 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_start", randomStart);
3828 if (auto randomEnd = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_end"))
3829 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_end", randomEnd);
3830
3831 // Move SV attributes.
3832 if (auto svAttrs = sv::getSVAttributes(op))
3833 sv::setSVAttributes(reg, svAttrs);
3834
3835 inputEdge.setValue(reg);
3836 (void)setLowering(op.getResult(), reg);
3837 return success();
3838}
3839
3840LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(RegResetOp op) {
3841 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getResult().getType());
3842 if (!resultType)
3843 return failure();
3844 if (resultType.isInteger(0))
3845 return setLowering(op.getResult(), Value());
3846
3847 Value clockVal = getLoweredValue(op.getClockVal());
3848 Value resetSignal = getLoweredValue(op.getResetSignal());
3849 // Reset values may be narrower than the register. Extend appropriately.
3850 Value resetValue = getLoweredAndExtOrTruncValue(
3851 op.getResetValue(), type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(op.getResult().getType()));
3852
3853 if (!clockVal || !resetSignal || !resetValue)
3854 return failure();
3855
3856 // Lower an optional `initial` time-zero value into a `seq.firreg` preset.
3857 Attribute presetAttr;
3858 if (auto initial = op.getInitialAttr()) {
3859 auto intTy = dyn_cast<IntegerType>(resultType);
3860 assert(intTy && "'initial' must be integer type");
3861 presetAttr = builder.getIntegerAttr(
3862 intTy, initial.getValue().zextOrTrunc(intTy.getWidth()));
3863 }
3864
3865 // Create a reg op, wiring itself to its input.
3866 auto innerSym = lowerInnerSymbol(op);
3867 bool isAsync = type_isa<AsyncResetType>(op.getResetSignal().getType());
3868 Backedge inputEdge = backedgeBuilder.get(resultType);
3869 auto reg = seq::FirRegOp::create(builder, inputEdge, clockVal,
3870 op.getNameAttr(), resetSignal, resetValue,
3871 innerSym, isAsync, presetAttr);
3872
3873 // Pass along the start and end random initialization bits for this register.
3874 if (auto randomRegister = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_register"))
3875 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_register", randomRegister);
3876 if (auto randomStart = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_start"))
3877 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_start", randomStart);
3878 if (auto randomEnd = op->getAttr("firrtl.random_init_end"))
3879 reg->setAttr("firrtl.random_init_end", randomEnd);
3880
3881 // Move SV attributes.
3882 if (auto svAttrs = sv::getSVAttributes(op))
3883 sv::setSVAttributes(reg, svAttrs);
3884
3885 inputEdge.setValue(reg);
3886 (void)setLowering(op.getResult(), reg);
3887
3888 return success();
3889}
3890
3891LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(MemOp op) {
3892 // TODO: Remove this restriction and preserve aggregates in
3893 // memories.
3894 if (type_isa<BundleType>(op.getDataType()))
3895 return op.emitOpError(
3896 "should have already been lowered from a ground type to an aggregate "
3897 "type using the LowerTypes pass. Use "
3898 "'firtool --lower-types' or 'circt-opt "
3899 "--pass-pipeline='firrtl.circuit(firrtl-lower-types)' "
3900 "to run this.");
3901
3902 FirMemory memSummary = op.getSummary();
3903
3904 // Create the memory declaration.
3905 auto memType = seq::FirMemType::get(
3906 op.getContext(), memSummary.depth, memSummary.dataWidth,
3907 memSummary.isMasked ? std::optional<uint32_t>(memSummary.maskBits)
3908 : std::optional<uint32_t>());
3909
3910 seq::FirMemInitAttr memInit;
3911 if (auto init = op.getInitAttr())
3912 memInit = seq::FirMemInitAttr::get(init.getContext(), init.getFilename(),
3913 init.getIsBinary(), init.getIsInline());
3914
3915 auto memDecl = seq::FirMemOp::create(
3916 builder, memType, memSummary.readLatency, memSummary.writeLatency,
3917 memSummary.readUnderWrite, memSummary.writeUnderWrite, op.getNameAttr(),
3918 op.getInnerSymAttr(), memInit, op.getPrefixAttr(), Attribute{});
3919
3920 if (auto parent = op->getParentOfType<hw::HWModuleOp>()) {
3921 if (auto file = parent->getAttrOfType<hw::OutputFileAttr>("output_file")) {
3922 auto dir = file;
3923 if (!file.isDirectory())
3924 dir = hw::OutputFileAttr::getAsDirectory(builder.getContext(),
3925 file.getDirectory());
3926 memDecl.setOutputFileAttr(dir);
3927 }
3928 }
3929
3930 // Memories return multiple structs, one for each port, which means we
3931 // have two layers of type to split apart.
3932 for (size_t i = 0, e = op.getNumResults(); i != e; ++i) {
3933
3934 auto addOutput = [&](StringRef field, size_t width, Value value) {
3935 for (auto &a : getAllFieldAccesses(op.getResult(i), field)) {
3936 if (width > 0)
3937 (void)setLowering(a, value);
3938 else
3939 a->eraseOperand(0);
3940 }
3941 };
3942
3943 auto addInput = [&](StringRef field, Value backedge) {
3944 for (auto a : getAllFieldAccesses(op.getResult(i), field)) {
3945 if (cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(a.getType())
3946 .getPassiveType()
3947 .getBitWidthOrSentinel() > 0)
3948 (void)setLowering(a, backedge);
3949 else
3950 a->eraseOperand(0);
3951 }
3952 };
3953
3954 auto addInputPort = [&](StringRef field, size_t width) -> Value {
3955 // If the memory is 0-width, do not materialize any connections to it.
3956 // However, `seq.firmem` now requires a 1-bit input, so materialize
3957 // a dummy x value to provide it with.
3958 Value backedge, portValue;
3959 if (width == 0) {
3960 portValue = getOrCreateXConstant(1);
3961 } else {
3962 auto portType = IntegerType::get(op.getContext(), width);
3963 backedge = portValue = createBackedge(builder.getLoc(), portType);
3964 }
3965 addInput(field, backedge);
3966 return portValue;
3967 };
3968
3969 auto addClock = [&](StringRef field) -> Value {
3970 Type clockTy = seq::ClockType::get(op.getContext());
3971 Value portValue = createBackedge(builder.getLoc(), clockTy);
3972 addInput(field, portValue);
3973 return portValue;
3974 };
3975
3976 auto memportKind = op.getPortKind(i);
3977 if (memportKind == MemOp::PortKind::Read) {
3978 auto addr = addInputPort("addr", op.getAddrBits());
3979 auto en = addInputPort("en", 1);
3980 auto clk = addClock("clk");
3981 auto data = seq::FirMemReadOp::create(builder, memDecl, addr, clk, en);
3982 addOutput("data", memSummary.dataWidth, data);
3983 } else if (memportKind == MemOp::PortKind::ReadWrite) {
3984 auto addr = addInputPort("addr", op.getAddrBits());
3985 auto en = addInputPort("en", 1);
3986 auto clk = addClock("clk");
3987 // If maskBits =1, then And the mask field with enable, and update the
3988 // enable. Else keep mask port.
3989 auto mode = addInputPort("wmode", 1);
3990 if (!memSummary.isMasked)
3991 mode = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(mode, addInputPort("wmask", 1),
3992 true);
3993 auto wdata = addInputPort("wdata", memSummary.dataWidth);
3994 // Ignore mask port, if maskBits =1
3995 Value mask;
3996 if (memSummary.isMasked)
3997 mask = addInputPort("wmask", memSummary.maskBits);
3998 auto rdata = seq::FirMemReadWriteOp::create(builder, memDecl, addr, clk,
3999 en, wdata, mode, mask);
4000 addOutput("rdata", memSummary.dataWidth, rdata);
4001 } else {
4002 auto addr = addInputPort("addr", op.getAddrBits());
4003 // If maskBits =1, then And the mask field with enable, and update the
4004 // enable. Else keep mask port.
4005 auto en = addInputPort("en", 1);
4006 if (!memSummary.isMasked)
4007 en = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(en, addInputPort("mask", 1),
4008 true);
4009 auto clk = addClock("clk");
4010 auto data = addInputPort("data", memSummary.dataWidth);
4011 // Ignore mask port, if maskBits =1
4012 Value mask;
4013 if (memSummary.isMasked)
4014 mask = addInputPort("mask", memSummary.maskBits);
4015 seq::FirMemWriteOp::create(builder, memDecl, addr, clk, en, data, mask);
4016 }
4017 }
4018
4019 return success();
4020}
4021
4022LogicalResult
4023FIRRTLLowering::prepareInstanceOperands(ArrayRef<PortInfo> portInfo,
4024 Operation *instanceOp,
4025 SmallVectorImpl<Value> &inputOperands) {
4026
4027 for (size_t portIndex = 0, e = portInfo.size(); portIndex != e; ++portIndex) {
4028 auto &port = portInfo[portIndex];
4029 auto portType = lowerType(port.type);
4030 if (!portType) {
4031 instanceOp->emitOpError("could not lower type of port ") << port.name;
4032 return failure();
4033 }
4034
4035 // Drop zero bit input/inout ports.
4036 if (portType.isInteger(0))
4037 continue;
4038
4039 // We wire outputs up after creating the instance.
4040 if (port.isOutput())
4041 continue;
4042
4043 auto portResult = instanceOp->getResult(portIndex);
4044 assert(portResult && "invalid IR, couldn't find port");
4045
4046 // Replace the input port with a backedge. If it turns out that this port
4047 // is never driven, an uninitialized wire will be materialized at the end.
4048 if (port.isInput()) {
4049 inputOperands.push_back(createBackedge(portResult, portType));
4050 continue;
4051 }
4052
4053 // If the result has an analog type and is used only by attach op, try
4054 // eliminating a temporary wire by directly using an attached value.
4055 if (type_isa<AnalogType>(portResult.getType()) && portResult.hasOneUse()) {
4056 if (auto attach = dyn_cast<AttachOp>(*portResult.getUsers().begin())) {
4057 if (auto source = getSingleNonInstanceOperand(attach)) {
4058 auto loweredResult = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(source);
4059 inputOperands.push_back(loweredResult);
4060 (void)setLowering(portResult, loweredResult);
4061 continue;
4062 }
4063 }
4064 }
4065
4066 // Create a wire for each inout operand, so there is something to connect
4067 // to. The instance becomes the sole driver of this wire.
4068 auto wire = sv::WireOp::create(builder, portType,
4069 "." + port.getName().str() + ".wire");
4070
4071 // Know that the argument FIRRTL value is equal to this wire, allowing
4072 // connects to it to be lowered.
4073 (void)setLowering(portResult, wire);
4074 inputOperands.push_back(wire);
4075 }
4076
4077 return success();
4078}
4079
4080LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(InstanceOp oldInstance) {
4081 Operation *oldModule =
4082 oldInstance.getReferencedModule(circuitState.getInstanceGraph());
4083
4084 auto *newModule = circuitState.getNewModule(oldModule);
4085 if (!newModule) {
4086 oldInstance->emitOpError("could not find module [")
4087 << oldInstance.getModuleName() << "] referenced by instance";
4088 return failure();
4089 }
4090
4091 // If this is a referenced to a parameterized extmodule, then bring the
4092 // parameters over to this instance.
4093 ArrayAttr parameters;
4094 if (auto oldExtModule = dyn_cast<FExtModuleOp>(oldModule))
4095 parameters = getHWParameters(oldExtModule, /*ignoreValues=*/false);
4096
4097 // Decode information about the input and output ports on the referenced
4098 // module.
4099 SmallVector<PortInfo, 8> portInfo = cast<FModuleLike>(oldModule).getPorts();
4100
4101 // Ok, get ready to create the new instance operation. We need to prepare
4102 // input operands.
4103 SmallVector<Value, 8> operands;
4104 if (failed(prepareInstanceOperands(portInfo, oldInstance, operands)))
4105 return failure();
4106
4107 // If this instance is destined to be lowered to a bind, generate a symbol
4108 // for it and generate a bind op. Enter the bind into global
4109 // CircuitLoweringState so that this can be moved outside of module once
4110 // we're guaranteed to not be a parallel context.
4111 auto innerSym = oldInstance.getInnerSymAttr();
4112 if (oldInstance.getLowerToBind()) {
4113 if (!innerSym)
4114 std::tie(innerSym, std::ignore) = getOrAddInnerSym(
4115 oldInstance.getContext(), oldInstance.getInnerSymAttr(), 0,
4116 [&]() -> hw::InnerSymbolNamespace & { return moduleNamespace; });
4117
4118 auto bindOp = sv::BindOp::create(builder, theModule.getNameAttr(),
4119 innerSym.getSymName());
4120 // If the lowered op already had output file information, then use that.
4121 // Otherwise, generate some default bind information.
4122 if (auto outputFile = oldInstance->getAttr("output_file"))
4123 bindOp->setAttr("output_file", outputFile);
4124 // Add the bind to the circuit state. This will be moved outside of the
4125 // encapsulating module after all modules have been processed in parallel.
4126 circuitState.addBind(bindOp);
4127 }
4128
4129 // Create the new hw.instance operation.
4130 auto newInstance =
4131 hw::InstanceOp::create(builder, newModule, oldInstance.getNameAttr(),
4132 operands, parameters, innerSym);
4133
4134 if (oldInstance.getLowerToBind() || oldInstance.getDoNotPrint())
4135 newInstance.setDoNotPrintAttr(builder.getUnitAttr());
4136
4137 if (newInstance.getInnerSymAttr())
4138 if (auto forceName = circuitState.instanceForceNames.lookup(
4139 {newInstance->getParentOfType<hw::HWModuleOp>().getNameAttr(),
4140 newInstance.getInnerNameAttr()}))
4141 newInstance->setAttr("hw.verilogName", forceName);
4142
4143 // Now that we have the new hw.instance, we need to remap all of the users
4144 // of the outputs/results to the values returned by the instance.
4145 unsigned resultNo = 0;
4146 for (size_t portIndex = 0, e = portInfo.size(); portIndex != e; ++portIndex) {
4147 auto &port = portInfo[portIndex];
4148 if (!port.isOutput() || isZeroBitFIRRTLType(port.type))
4149 continue;
4150
4151 Value resultVal = newInstance.getResult(resultNo);
4152
4153 auto oldPortResult = oldInstance.getResult(portIndex);
4154 (void)setLowering(oldPortResult, resultVal);
4155 ++resultNo;
4156 }
4157 return success();
4158}
4159
4160LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(InstanceChoiceOp oldInstanceChoice) {
4161 if (oldInstanceChoice.getInnerSymAttr()) {
4162 oldInstanceChoice->emitOpError(
4163 "instance choice with inner sym cannot be lowered");
4164 return failure();
4165 }
4166
4167 // Require instance_macro to be set before lowering
4168 FlatSymbolRefAttr instanceMacro = oldInstanceChoice.getInstanceMacroAttr();
4169 if (!instanceMacro)
4170 return oldInstanceChoice->emitOpError(
4171 "must have instance_macro attribute set before "
4172 "lowering");
4173
4174 // Get all the target modules
4175 auto moduleNames = oldInstanceChoice.getModuleNamesAttr();
4176 auto caseNames = oldInstanceChoice.getCaseNamesAttr();
4177
4178 // Get the default module.
4179 auto defaultModuleName = oldInstanceChoice.getDefaultTargetAttr();
4180 auto *defaultModuleNode =
4181 circuitState.getInstanceGraph().lookup(defaultModuleName.getAttr());
4182
4183 Operation *defaultModule = defaultModuleNode->getModule();
4184
4185 // Get port information from the default module (all alternatives must have
4186 // same ports).
4187 SmallVector<PortInfo, 8> portInfo =
4188 cast<FModuleLike>(defaultModule).getPorts();
4189
4190 // Prepare input operands.
4191 SmallVector<Value, 8> inputOperands;
4192 if (failed(
4193 prepareInstanceOperands(portInfo, oldInstanceChoice, inputOperands)))
4194 return failure();
4195
4196 // Create wires for output ports.
4197 SmallVector<sv::WireOp, 8> outputWires;
4198 StringRef wirePrefix = oldInstanceChoice.getInstanceName();
4199 for (size_t portIndex = 0, e = portInfo.size(); portIndex != e; ++portIndex) {
4200 auto &port = portInfo[portIndex];
4201 if (port.isInput())
4202 continue;
4203 auto portType = lowerType(port.type);
4204 if (!portType || portType.isInteger(0))
4205 continue;
4206 auto wire = sv::WireOp::create(
4207 builder, portType, wirePrefix.str() + "." + port.getName().str());
4208 outputWires.push_back(wire);
4209 if (failed(setLowering(oldInstanceChoice.getResult(portIndex), wire)))
4210 return failure();
4211 }
4212
4213 auto optionName = oldInstanceChoice.getOptionNameAttr();
4214
4215 // Lambda to create an instance for a given module and assign outputs to wires
4216 auto createInstanceAndAssign = [&](Operation *oldMod,
4217 StringRef suffix) -> hw::InstanceOp {
4218 auto *newMod = circuitState.getNewModule(oldMod);
4219
4220 ArrayAttr parameters;
4221 if (auto oldExtModule = dyn_cast<FExtModuleOp>(oldMod))
4222 parameters = getHWParameters(oldExtModule, /*ignoreValues=*/false);
4223
4224 // Create instance name with suffix
4225 SmallString<64> instName;
4226 instName = oldInstanceChoice.getInstanceName();
4227 if (!suffix.empty()) {
4228 instName += "_";
4229 instName += suffix;
4230 }
4231
4232 auto inst =
4233 hw::InstanceOp::create(builder, newMod, builder.getStringAttr(instName),
4234 inputOperands, parameters, nullptr);
4235 (void)getOrAddInnerSym(
4236 hw::InnerSymTarget(inst.getOperation()),
4237 [&]() -> hw::InnerSymbolNamespace & { return moduleNamespace; });
4238
4239 // Assign instance outputs to the wires
4240 for (unsigned i = 0; i < inst.getNumResults(); ++i)
4241 sv::AssignOp::create(builder, outputWires[i], inst.getResult(i));
4242
4243 return inst;
4244 };
4245
4246 // Build macro names and module list for nested ifdefs.
4247 SmallVector<StringAttr> macroNames;
4248 SmallVector<Operation *> altModules;
4249 for (size_t i = 0, e = caseNames.size(); i < e; ++i) {
4250 altModules.push_back(
4251 circuitState.getInstanceGraph()
4252 .lookup(cast<FlatSymbolRefAttr>(moduleNames[i + 1]).getAttr())
4253 ->getModule());
4254
4255 // Get the macro name for this option case using InstanceChoiceMacroTable.
4256 auto optionCaseMacroRef = circuitState.macroTable.getMacro(
4257 optionName, cast<SymbolRefAttr>(caseNames[i]).getLeafReference());
4258 if (!optionCaseMacroRef)
4259 return oldInstanceChoice->emitOpError(
4260 "failed to get macro for option case");
4261 macroNames.push_back(optionCaseMacroRef.getAttr());
4262 }
4263
4264 // Use the helper function to create nested ifdefs.
4265 sv::createNestedIfDefs(
4266 macroNames,
4267 /*ifdefCtor=*/
4268 [&](StringRef macro, std::function<void()> thenCtor,
4269 std::function<void()> elseCtor) {
4270 addToIfDefBlock(macro, std::move(thenCtor), std::move(elseCtor));
4271 },
4272 [&](size_t index) {
4273 // Add mutual exclusion checks for all other options
4274 for (size_t i = index + 1; i < macroNames.size(); ++i) {
4275 sv::IfDefOp::create(
4276 builder, oldInstanceChoice.getLoc(), macroNames[i],
4277 [&]() {
4278 SmallString<256> errorMessage;
4279 llvm::raw_svector_ostream os(errorMessage);
4280 os << "Multiple instance choice options defined for option '"
4281 << optionName.getValue() << "': '"
4282 << macroNames[index].getValue() << "' and '"
4283 << macroNames[i].getValue() << "'";
4284 sv::ErrorOp::create(builder, oldInstanceChoice.getLoc(),
4285 builder.getStringAttr(errorMessage));
4286 },
4287 [&]() {});
4288 }
4289
4290 auto caseSymRef =
4291 cast<SymbolRefAttr>(caseNames[index]).getLeafReference();
4292 auto inst =
4293 createInstanceAndAssign(altModules[index], caseSymRef.getValue());
4294 // Define the instance macro for this case.
4295 sv::MacroDefOp::create(builder, inst.getLoc(), instanceMacro,
4296 builder.getStringAttr("{{0}}"),
4297 builder.getArrayAttr({hw::InnerRefAttr::get(
4298 theModule.getNameAttr(),
4299 inst.getInnerSymAttr().getSymName())}));
4300 },
4301 [&]() {
4302 // Generate an error when no instance choice option is selected.
4303 SmallString<256> errorMessage;
4304 llvm::raw_svector_ostream os(errorMessage);
4305 os << "Required instance choice option '" << optionName.getValue()
4306 << "' not selected, must define one of: ";
4307 llvm::interleaveComma(macroNames, os, [&](StringAttr macro) {
4308 os << "'" << macro.getValue() << "'";
4309 });
4310 sv::ErrorOp::create(builder, oldInstanceChoice.getLoc(),
4311 builder.getStringAttr(errorMessage));
4312 });
4313
4314 return success();
4315}
4316
4317LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitDecl(ContractOp oldOp) {
4318 SmallVector<Value> inputs;
4319 SmallVector<Type> types;
4320 for (auto input : oldOp.getInputs()) {
4321 auto lowered = getLoweredValue(input);
4322 if (!lowered)
4323 return failure();
4324 inputs.push_back(lowered);
4325 types.push_back(lowered.getType());
4326 }
4327
4328 auto newOp = verif::ContractOp::create(builder, types, inputs);
4329 newOp->setDiscardableAttrs(oldOp->getDiscardableAttrDictionary());
4330 auto &body = newOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
4331
4332 for (auto [newResult, oldResult, oldArg] :
4333 llvm::zip(newOp.getResults(), oldOp.getResults(),
4334 oldOp.getBody().getArguments())) {
4335 if (failed(setLowering(oldResult, newResult)))
4336 return failure();
4337 if (failed(setLowering(oldArg, newResult)))
4338 return failure();
4339 }
4340
4341 body.getOperations().splice(body.end(),
4342 oldOp.getBody().front().getOperations());
4343 addToWorklist(body);
4344
4345 return success();
4346}

4352// Lower a cast that is a noop at the HW level.
4353LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerNoopCast(Operation *op) {
4354 auto operand = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op->getOperand(0));
4355 if (!operand)
4356 return failure();
4357
4358 // Noop cast.
4359 return setLowering(op->getResult(0), operand);
4360}

4362LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(AsSIntPrimOp op) {
4363 if (isa<ClockType>(op.getInput().getType()))
4364 return setLowering(op->getResult(0),
4365 getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getInput()));
4366 return lowerNoopCast(op);
4367}

4369LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(AsUIntPrimOp op) {
4370 if (isa<ClockType>(op.getInput().getType()))
4371 return setLowering(op->getResult(0),
4372 getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getInput()));
4373 return lowerNoopCast(op);

4376LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(AsClockPrimOp op) {

4379
4380LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitUnrealizedConversionCast(
4381 mlir::UnrealizedConversionCastOp op) {
4382 // General lowering for non-unary casts.
4383 if (op.getNumOperands() != 1 || op.getNumResults() != 1)
4384 return failure();
4385
4386 auto operand = op.getOperand(0);
4387 auto result = op.getResult(0);
4388
4389 // FIRRTL -> FIRRTL
4390 if (type_isa<FIRRTLType>(operand.getType()) &&
4391 type_isa<FIRRTLType>(result.getType()))
4392 return lowerNoopCast(op);
4393
4394 // other -> FIRRTL
4395 // other -> other
4396 if (!type_isa<FIRRTLType>(operand.getType())) {
4397 if (type_isa<FIRRTLType>(result.getType()))
4398 return setLowering(result, getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(operand));
4399 return failure(); // general foreign op lowering for other -> other
4400 }
4401
4402 // FIRRTL -> other
4403 // Otherwise must be a conversion from FIRRTL type to standard type.
4404 auto loweredResult = getLoweredValue(operand);
4405 if (!loweredResult) {
4406 // If this is a conversion from a zero bit HW type to firrtl value, then
4407 // we want to successfully lower this to a null Value.
4408 if (operand.getType().isSignlessInteger(0)) {
4409 return setLowering(result, Value());
4410 }
4411 return failure();
4412 }
4413
4414 // We lower builtin.unrealized_conversion_cast converting from a firrtl type
4415 // to a standard type into the lowered operand.
4416 result.replaceAllUsesWith(loweredResult);
4417 return success();
4418}
4419
4420LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(HWStructCastOp op) {
4421 // Conversions from hw struct types to FIRRTL types are lowered as the
4422 // input operand.
4423 if (auto opStructType = dyn_cast<hw::StructType>(op.getOperand().getType()))
4424 return setLowering(op, op.getOperand());
4425
4426 // Otherwise must be a conversion from FIRRTL bundle type to hw struct
4427 // type.
4428 auto result = getLoweredValue(op.getOperand());
4429 if (!result)
4430 return failure();
4431
4432 // We lower firrtl.stdStructCast converting from a firrtl bundle to an hw
4433 // struct type into the lowered operand.
4434 op.replaceAllUsesWith(result);
4435 return success();
4436}
4437
4438LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(BitCastOp op) {
4439 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getOperand());
4440 if (!operand)
4441 return failure();
4442 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getType());
4443 if (!resultType)
4444 return failure();
4445
4446 return setLoweringTo<hw::BitcastOp>(op, resultType, operand);
4447}
4448
4449LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(CvtPrimOp op) {
4450 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getOperand());
4451 if (!operand) {
4452 return handleZeroBit(op.getOperand(), [&]() {
4453 // Unsigned zero bit to Signed is 1b0.
4454 if (type_cast<IntType>(op.getOperand().getType()).isUnsigned())
4455 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0));
4456 // Signed->Signed is a zero bit value.
4457 return setLowering(op, Value());
4458 });
4459 }
4460
4461 // Signed to signed is a noop.
4462 if (type_cast<IntType>(op.getOperand().getType()).isSigned())
4463 return setLowering(op, operand);
4464
4465 // Otherwise prepend a zero bit.
4466 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0);
4467 return setLoweringTo<comb::ConcatOp>(op, zero, operand);
4468}
4469
4470LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(NotPrimOp op) {
4471 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4472 if (!operand)
4473 return failure();
4474 // ~x ---> x ^ 0xFF
4475 auto allOnes = getOrCreateIntConstant(
4476 APInt::getAllOnes(operand.getType().getIntOrFloatBitWidth()));
4477 return setLoweringTo<comb::XorOp>(op, operand, allOnes, true);
4478}
4479
4480LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(NegPrimOp op) {
4481 // FIRRTL negate always adds a bit.
4482 // -x ---> 0-sext(x) or 0-zext(x)
4483 auto operand = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getInput(), op.getType());
4484 if (!operand)
4485 return failure();
4486
4487 auto resultType = lowerType(op.getType());
4488
4489 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(resultType.getIntOrFloatBitWidth(), 0);
4490 return setLoweringTo<comb::SubOp>(op, zero, operand, true);
4491}
4492
4493// Pad is a noop or extension operation.
4494LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(PadPrimOp op) {
4495 auto operand = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getInput(), op.getType());
4496 if (!operand)
4497 return failure();
4498 return setLowering(op, operand);
4499}
4500
4501LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(XorRPrimOp op) {
4502 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4503 if (!operand) {
4504 return handleZeroBit(op.getInput(), [&]() {
4505 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0));
4506 });
4507 return failure();
4508 }
4509
4510 return setLoweringTo<comb::ParityOp>(op, builder.getIntegerType(1), operand,
4511 true);
4512}
4513
4514LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(AndRPrimOp op) {
4515 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4516 if (!operand) {
4517 return handleZeroBit(op.getInput(), [&]() {
4518 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 1));
4519 });
4520 }
4521
4522 // Lower AndR to == -1
4523 return setLoweringTo<comb::ICmpOp>(
4524 op, ICmpPredicate::eq, operand,
4525 getOrCreateIntConstant(
4526 APInt::getAllOnes(operand.getType().getIntOrFloatBitWidth())),
4527 true);
4528}
4529
4530LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(OrRPrimOp op) {
4531 auto operand = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4532 if (!operand) {
4533 return handleZeroBit(op.getInput(), [&]() {
4534 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0));
4535 });
4536 return failure();
4537 }
4538
4539 // Lower OrR to != 0
4540 return setLoweringTo<comb::ICmpOp>(
4541 op, ICmpPredicate::ne, operand,
4542 getOrCreateIntConstant(operand.getType().getIntOrFloatBitWidth(), 0),
4543 true);
4544}
