4546//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
4547// Binary Operations
4548//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
4549
4550template <typename ResultOpType>
4551LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerBinOpToVariadic(Operation *op) {
4552 auto resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
4553 auto lhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(0), resultType);
4554 auto rhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(1), resultType);
4555 if (!lhs || !rhs)
4556 return failure();
4557
4558 return setLoweringTo<ResultOpType>(op, lhs, rhs, true);
4559}
4560
4561/// Element-wise logical operations can be lowered into bitcast and normal comb
4562/// operations. Eventually we might want to introduce elementwise operations
4563/// into HW/SV level as well.
4564template <typename ResultOpType>
4565LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerElementwiseLogicalOp(Operation *op) {
4566 auto resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
4567 auto lhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(0), resultType);
4568 auto rhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(1), resultType);
4569
4570 if (!lhs || !rhs)
4571 return failure();
4572 auto bitwidth = firrtl::getBitWidth(type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(resultType));
4573
4574 if (!bitwidth)
4575 return failure();
4576
4577 // TODO: Introduce elementwise operations to HW dialect instead of abusing
4578 // bitcast operations.
4579 auto intType = builder.getIntegerType(*bitwidth);
4580 auto retType = lhs.getType();
4581 lhs = builder.createOrFold<hw::BitcastOp>(intType, lhs);
4582 rhs = builder.createOrFold<hw::BitcastOp>(intType, rhs);
4583 auto result = builder.createOrFold<ResultOpType>(lhs, rhs, /*twoState=*/true);
4584 return setLoweringTo<hw::BitcastOp>(op, retType, result);
4585}
4586
4587/// lowerBinOp extends each operand to the destination type, then performs the
4588/// specified binary operator.
4589template <typename ResultUnsignedOpType, typename ResultSignedOpType>
4590LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerBinOp(Operation *op) {
4591 // Extend the two operands to match the destination type.
4592 auto resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
4593 auto lhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(0), resultType);
4594 auto rhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(1), resultType);
4595 if (!lhs || !rhs)
4596 return failure();
4597
4598 // Emit the result operation.
4599 if (type_cast<IntType>(resultType).isSigned())
4600 return setLoweringTo<ResultSignedOpType>(op, lhs, rhs, true);
4601 return setLoweringTo<ResultUnsignedOpType>(op, lhs, rhs, true);
4602}
4603
4604/// lowerCmpOp extends each operand to the longest type, then performs the
4605/// specified binary operator.
4606LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerCmpOp(Operation *op, ICmpPredicate signedOp,
4607 ICmpPredicate unsignedOp) {
4608 // Extend the two operands to match the longest type.
4609 auto lhsIntType = type_cast<IntType>(op->getOperand(0).getType());
4610 auto rhsIntType = type_cast<IntType>(op->getOperand(1).getType());
4611 if (!lhsIntType.hasWidth() || !rhsIntType.hasWidth())
4612 return failure();
4613
4614 auto cmpType = getWidestIntType(lhsIntType, rhsIntType);
4615 if (cmpType.getWidth() == 0) // Handle 0-width inputs by promoting to 1 bit.
4616 cmpType = UIntType::get(builder.getContext(), 1);
4617 auto lhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(0), cmpType);
4618 auto rhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(1), cmpType);
4619 if (!lhs || !rhs)
4620 return failure();
4621
4622 // Emit the result operation.
4623 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(1);
4624 return setLoweringTo<comb::ICmpOp>(
4625 op, resultType, lhsIntType.isSigned() ? signedOp : unsignedOp, lhs, rhs,
4626 true);
4627}
4628
4629/// Lower a divide or dynamic shift, where the operation has to be performed
4630/// in the widest type of the result and two inputs then truncated down.
4631template <typename SignedOp, typename UnsignedOp>
4632LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerDivLikeOp(Operation *op) {
4633 // hw has equal types for these, firrtl doesn't. The type of the firrtl
4634 // RHS may be wider than the LHS, and we cannot truncate off the high bits
4635 // (because an overlarge amount is supposed to shift in sign or zero bits).
4636 auto opType = type_cast<IntType>(op->getResult(0).getType());
4637 if (opType.getWidth() == 0)
4638 return setLowering(op->getResult(0), Value());
4639
4640 auto resultType = getWidestIntType(opType, op->getOperand(1).getType());
4641 resultType = getWidestIntType(resultType, op->getOperand(0).getType());
4642 auto lhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(0), resultType);
4643 auto rhs = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op->getOperand(1), resultType);
4644 if (!lhs || !rhs)
4645 return failure();
4646
4647 Value result;
4648 if (opType.isSigned())
4649 result = builder.createOrFold<SignedOp>(lhs, rhs, true);
4650 else
4651 result = builder.createOrFold<UnsignedOp>(lhs, rhs, true);
4652
4653 if (auto *definingOp = result.getDefiningOp())
4654 tryCopyName(definingOp, op);
4655
4656 if (resultType == opType)
4657 return setLowering(op->getResult(0), result);
4658 return setLoweringTo<comb::ExtractOp>(op, lowerType(opType), result, 0);
4659}
4660
4661LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(CatPrimOp op) {
4662 // Handle the case of no operands - should result in a 0-bit value
4663 if (op.getInputs().empty())
4664 return setLowering(op, Value());
4665
4666 SmallVector<Value> loweredOperands;
4667
4668 // Lower all operands, filtering out zero-bit values
4669 for (auto operand : op.getInputs()) {
4670 auto loweredOperand = getLoweredValue(operand);
4671 if (loweredOperand) {
4672 loweredOperands.push_back(loweredOperand);
4673 } else {
4674 // Check if this is a zero-bit operand, which we can skip
4675 auto result = handleZeroBit(operand, [&]() { return success(); });
4676 if (failed(result))
4677 return failure();
4678 // Zero-bit operands are skipped (not added to loweredOperands)
4679 }
4680 }
4681
4682 // If no non-zero operands, return 0-bit value
4683 if (loweredOperands.empty())
4684 return setLowering(op, Value());
4685
4686 // Use comb.concat
4687 return setLoweringTo<comb::ConcatOp>(op, loweredOperands);
4688}

4694LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(IsXIntrinsicOp op) {
4695 auto input = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getArg());
4696 if (!input)
4697 return failure();
4698
4699 if (!isa<IntType>(input.getType())) {
4700 auto srcType = op.getArg().getType();
4701 auto bitwidth = firrtl::getBitWidth(type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(srcType));
4702 assert(bitwidth && "Unknown width");
4703 auto intType = builder.getIntegerType(*bitwidth);
4704 input = builder.createOrFold<hw::BitcastOp>(intType, input);
4705 }
4706
4707 return setLoweringTo<comb::ICmpOp>(
4708 op, ICmpPredicate::ceq, input,
4709 getOrCreateXConstant(input.getType().getIntOrFloatBitWidth()), true);
4710}

4832static ltl::ClockEdge firrtlToLTLClockEdge(EventControl eventControl) {
4833 switch (eventControl) {
4834 case EventControl::AtPosEdge:
4835 return ltl::ClockEdge::Pos;
4836 case EventControl::AtEdge:
4837 return ltl::ClockEdge::Both;
4838 case EventControl::AtNegEdge:
4839 return ltl::ClockEdge::Neg;
4840 }
4841 llvm_unreachable("unknown event control");
4842}

4847 getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getClock()));
4848}

4870LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(VerifRequireIntrinsicOp op) {
4871 if (!isa<verif::ContractOp>(op->getParentOp()))
4872 return lowerVerifIntrinsicOp<verif::AssertOp>(op);
4873 return lowerVerifIntrinsicOp<verif::RequireOp>(op);
4874}
4875
4876LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(VerifEnsureIntrinsicOp op) {
4877 if (!isa<verif::ContractOp>(op->getParentOp()))
4878 return lowerVerifIntrinsicOp<verif::AssertOp>(op);
4879 return lowerVerifIntrinsicOp<verif::EnsureOp>(op);
4880}
4881
4882LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(HasBeenResetIntrinsicOp op) {
4883 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getClock());
4884 auto reset = getLoweredValue(op.getReset());
4885 if (!clock || !reset)
4886 return failure();
4887 auto resetType = op.getReset().getType();
4888 auto uintResetType = dyn_cast<UIntType>(resetType);
4889 auto isSync = uintResetType && uintResetType.getWidth() == 1;
4890 auto isAsync = isa<AsyncResetType>(resetType);
4891 if (!isAsync && !isSync) {
4892 auto d = op.emitError("uninferred reset passed to 'has_been_reset'; "
4893 "requires sync or async reset");
4894 d.attachNote() << "reset is of type " << resetType
4895 << ", should be '!firrtl.uint<1>' or '!firrtl.asyncreset'";
4896 return failure();
4897 }
4898 return setLoweringTo<verif::HasBeenResetOp>(op, clock, reset, isAsync);
4899}

4901//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
4902// Other Operations
4903//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
4904
4905LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(BitsPrimOp op) {
4906 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4907 if (!input)
4908 return failure();
4909
4910 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(op.getHi() - op.getLo() + 1);
4911 return setLoweringTo<comb::ExtractOp>(op, resultType, input, op.getLo());
4912}
4913
4914LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(InvalidValueOp op) {
4915 auto resultTy = lowerType(op.getType());
4916 if (!resultTy)
4917 return failure();
4918
4919 // Values of analog type always need to be lowered to something with inout
4920 // type. We do that by lowering to a wire and return that. As with the
4921 // SFC, we do not connect anything to this, because it is bidirectional.
4922 if (type_isa<AnalogType>(op.getType()))
4923 // This is a locally visible, private wire created by the compiler, so do
4924 // not attach a symbol name.
4925 return setLoweringTo<sv::WireOp>(op, resultTy, ".invalid_analog");
4926
4927 // We don't allow aggregate values which contain values of analog types.
4928 if (type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(op.getType()).containsAnalog())
4929 return failure();
4930
4931 // We lower invalid to 0. TODO: the FIRRTL spec mentions something about
4932 // lowering it to a random value, we should see if this is what we need to
4933 // do.
4934 if (auto bitwidth =
4935 firrtl::getBitWidth(type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(op.getType()))) {
4936 if (*bitwidth == 0) // Let the caller handle zero width values.
4937 return failure();
4938
4939 auto constant = getOrCreateIntConstant(*bitwidth, 0);
4940 // If the result is an aggregate value, we have to bitcast the constant.
4941 if (!type_isa<IntegerType>(resultTy))
4942 constant = hw::BitcastOp::create(builder, resultTy, constant);
4943 return setLowering(op, constant);
4944 }
4945
4946 // Invalid for bundles isn't supported.
4947 op.emitOpError("unsupported type");
4948 return failure();
4949}
4950
4951LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(HeadPrimOp op) {
4952 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4953 if (!input)
4954 return failure();
4955 auto inWidth = type_cast<IntegerType>(input.getType()).getWidth();
4956 if (op.getAmount() == 0)
4957 return setLowering(op, Value());
4958 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(op.getAmount());
4959 return setLoweringTo<comb::ExtractOp>(op, resultType, input,
4960 inWidth - op.getAmount());
4961}
4962
4963LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(ShlPrimOp op) {
4964 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4965 if (!input) {
4966 return handleZeroBit(op.getInput(), [&]() {
4967 if (op.getAmount() == 0)
4968 return failure();
4969 return setLowering(op, getOrCreateIntConstant(op.getAmount(), 0));
4970 });
4971 }
4972
4973 // Handle the degenerate case.
4974 if (op.getAmount() == 0)
4975 return setLowering(op, input);
4976
4977 auto zero = getOrCreateIntConstant(op.getAmount(), 0);
4978 return setLoweringTo<comb::ConcatOp>(op, input, zero);
4979}
4980
4981LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(ShrPrimOp op) {
4982 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
4983 if (!input)
4984 return failure();
4985
4986 // Handle the special degenerate cases.
4987 auto inWidth = type_cast<IntegerType>(input.getType()).getWidth();
4988 auto shiftAmount = op.getAmount();
4989 if (shiftAmount >= inWidth) {
4990 // Unsigned shift by full width returns a single-bit zero.
4991 if (type_cast<IntType>(op.getInput().getType()).isUnsigned())
4992 return setLowering(op, {});
4993
4994 // Signed shift by full width is equivalent to extracting the sign bit.
4995 shiftAmount = inWidth - 1;
4996 }
4997
4998 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(inWidth - shiftAmount);
4999 return setLoweringTo<comb::ExtractOp>(op, resultType, input, shiftAmount);
5000}
5001
5002LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(TailPrimOp op) {
5003 auto input = getLoweredValue(op.getInput());
5004 if (!input)
5005 return failure();
5006
5007 auto inWidth = type_cast<IntegerType>(input.getType()).getWidth();
5008 if (inWidth == op.getAmount())
5009 return setLowering(op, Value());
5010 Type resultType = builder.getIntegerType(inWidth - op.getAmount());
5011 return setLoweringTo<comb::ExtractOp>(op, resultType, input, 0);
5012}
5013
5014LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(MuxPrimOp op) {
5015 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getSel());
5016 auto ifTrue = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getHigh(), op.getType());
5017 auto ifFalse = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getLow(), op.getType());
5018 if (!cond || !ifTrue || !ifFalse)
5019 return failure();
5020
5021 if (isa<ClockType>(op.getType()))
5022 return setLoweringTo<seq::ClockMuxOp>(op, cond, ifTrue, ifFalse);
5023 return setLoweringTo<comb::MuxOp>(op, ifTrue.getType(), cond, ifTrue, ifFalse,
5024 true);
5025}
5026
5027LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(Mux2CellIntrinsicOp op) {
5028 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getSel());
5029 auto ifTrue = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getHigh(), op.getType());
5030 auto ifFalse = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getLow(), op.getType());
5031 if (!cond || !ifTrue || !ifFalse)
5032 return failure();
5033
5034 auto val = comb::MuxOp::create(builder, ifTrue.getType(), cond, ifTrue,
5035 ifFalse, true);
5036 return setLowering(op, createValueWithMuxAnnotation(val, true));
5037}
5038
5039LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(Mux4CellIntrinsicOp op) {
5040 auto sel = getLoweredValue(op.getSel());
5041 auto v3 = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getV3(), op.getType());
5042 auto v2 = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getV2(), op.getType());
5043 auto v1 = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getV1(), op.getType());
5044 auto v0 = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getV0(), op.getType());
5045 if (!sel || !v3 || !v2 || !v1 || !v0)
5046 return failure();
5047 Value array[] = {v3, v2, v1, v0};
5048 auto create = hw::ArrayCreateOp::create(builder, array);
5049 auto val = hw::ArrayGetOp::create(builder, create, sel);
5050 return setLowering(op, createValueWithMuxAnnotation(val, false));
5051}
5052
5053// Construct a value with vendor specific pragmas to utilize MUX cells.
5054// Specifically we annotate pragmas in the following form.
5055//
5056// For an array indexing:
5057// ```
5058// wire GEN;
5059// /* synopsys infer_mux_override */
5060// assign GEN = array[index] /* cadence map_to_mux */;
5061// ```
5062//
5063// For a mux:
5064// ```
5065// wire GEN;
5066// /* synopsys infer_mux_override */
5067// assign GEN = sel ? /* cadence map_to_mux */ high : low;
5068// ```
5069Value FIRRTLLowering::createValueWithMuxAnnotation(Operation *op, bool isMux2) {
5070 assert(op->getNumResults() == 1 && "only expect a single result");
5071 auto val = op->getResult(0);
5072 auto valWire = sv::WireOp::create(builder, val.getType());
5073 // Use SV attributes to annotate pragmas.
5074 circt::sv::setSVAttributes(
5075 op, sv::SVAttributeAttr::get(builder.getContext(), "cadence map_to_mux",
5076 /*emitAsComment=*/true));
5077
5078 // For operands, create temporary wires with optimization blockers(inner
5079 // symbols) so that the AST structure will never be destoyed in the later
5080 // pipeline.
5081 {
5082 OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);
5083 builder.setInsertionPoint(op);
5084 StringRef namehint = isMux2 ? "mux2cell_in" : "mux4cell_in";
5085 for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(op->getOperands())) {
5086 auto [innerSym, _] = getOrAddInnerSym(
5087 op->getContext(), /*attr=*/nullptr, 0,
5088 [&]() -> hw::InnerSymbolNamespace & { return moduleNamespace; });
5089 auto wire =
5090 hw::WireOp::create(builder, operand, namehint + Twine(idx), innerSym);
5091 op->setOperand(idx, wire);
5092 }
5093 }
5094
5095 auto assignOp = sv::AssignOp::create(builder, valWire, val);
5096 sv::setSVAttributes(assignOp,
5097 sv::SVAttributeAttr::get(builder.getContext(),
5098 "synopsys infer_mux_override",
5099 /*emitAsComment=*/true));
5100 return sv::ReadInOutOp::create(builder, valWire);
5101}
5102
5103Value FIRRTLLowering::createArrayIndexing(Value array, Value index) {
5104
5105 auto size = hw::type_cast<hw::ArrayType>(array.getType()).getNumElements();
5106 // Extend to power of 2. FIRRTL semantics say out-of-bounds access result in
5107 // an indeterminate value. Existing chisel code depends on this behavior
5108 // being "return index 0". Ideally, we would tail extend the array to improve
5109 // optimization.
5110 if (!llvm::isPowerOf2_64(size)) {
5111 auto extElem = getOrCreateIntConstant(APInt(llvm::Log2_64_Ceil(size), 0));
5112 auto extValue = hw::ArrayGetOp::create(builder, array, extElem);
5113 SmallVector<Value> temp(llvm::NextPowerOf2(size) - size, extValue);
5114 auto ext = hw::ArrayCreateOp::create(builder, temp);
5115 Value temp2[] = {ext.getResult(), array};
5116 array = hw::ArrayConcatOp::create(builder, temp2);
5117 }
5118
5119 Value inBoundsRead = hw::ArrayGetOp::create(builder, array, index);
5120
5121 return inBoundsRead;
5122}
5123
5124LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(MultibitMuxOp op) {
5125 // Lower and resize to the index width.
5126 auto index = getLoweredAndExtOrTruncValue(
5127 op.getIndex(),
5128 UIntType::get(op.getContext(),
5129 getBitWidthFromVectorSize(op.getInputs().size())));
5130
5131 if (!index)
5132 return failure();
5133 SmallVector<Value> loweredInputs;
5134 loweredInputs.reserve(op.getInputs().size());
5135 for (auto input : op.getInputs()) {
5136 auto lowered = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(input, op.getType());
5137 if (!lowered)
5138 return failure();
5139 loweredInputs.push_back(lowered);
5140 }
5141
5142 Value array = hw::ArrayCreateOp::create(builder, loweredInputs);
5143 return setLowering(op, createArrayIndexing(array, index));
5144}
5145
5146LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(VerbatimExprOp op) {
5147 auto resultTy = lowerType(op.getType());
5148 if (!resultTy)
5149 return failure();
5150
5151 SmallVector<Value, 4> operands;
5152 operands.reserve(op.getSubstitutions().size());
5153 for (auto operand : op.getSubstitutions()) {
5154 auto lowered = getLoweredValue(operand);
5155 if (!lowered)
5156 return failure();
5157 operands.push_back(lowered);
5158 }
5159
5160 ArrayAttr symbols = op.getSymbolsAttr();
5161 if (!symbols)
5162 symbols = ArrayAttr::get(op.getContext(), {});
5163
5164 return setLoweringTo<sv::VerbatimExprOp>(op, resultTy, op.getTextAttr(),
5165 operands, symbols);
5166}
5167
5168LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(XMRRefOp op) {
5169 // This XMR is accessed solely by FIRRTL statements that mutate the probe.
5170 // To avoid the use of clock wires, create an `i1` wire and ensure that
5171 // all connections are also of the `i1` type.
5172 Type baseType = op.getType().getType();
5173
5174 Type xmrType;
5175 if (isa<ClockType>(baseType))
5176 xmrType = builder.getIntegerType(1);
5177 else
5178 xmrType = lowerType(baseType);
5179
5180 return setLoweringTo<sv::XMRRefOp>(op, sv::InOutType::get(xmrType),
5181 op.getRef(), op.getVerbatimSuffixAttr());
5182}
5183
5184LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitExpr(XMRDerefOp op) {
5185 // When an XMR targets a clock wire, replace it with an `i1` wire, but
5186 // introduce a clock-typed read op into the design afterwards.
5187 Type xmrType;
5188 if (isa<ClockType>(op.getType()))
5189 xmrType = builder.getIntegerType(1);
5190 else
5191 xmrType = lowerType(op.getType());
5192
5193 auto xmr = sv::XMRRefOp::create(builder, sv::InOutType::get(xmrType),
5194 op.getRef(), op.getVerbatimSuffixAttr());
5195 auto readXmr = getReadValue(xmr);
5196 if (!isa<ClockType>(op.getType()))
5197 return setLowering(op, readXmr);
5198 return setLoweringTo<seq::ToClockOp>(op, readXmr);
5199}

5212LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(SkipOp op) {

5214 // reason to.

5217
5218/// Resolve a connection to `destVal`, an `hw::WireOp` or `seq::FirRegOp`, by
5219/// updating the input operand to be `srcVal`. Returns true if the update was
5220/// made and the connection can be considered lowered. Returns false if the
5221/// destination isn't a wire or register with an input operand to be updated.
5222/// Returns failure if the destination is a subaccess operation. These should be
5223/// transposed to the right-hand-side by a pre-pass.
5224FailureOr<bool> FIRRTLLowering::lowerConnect(Value destVal, Value srcVal) {
5225 auto srcType = srcVal.getType();
5226 auto dstType = destVal.getType();
5227 if (srcType != dstType &&
5228 (isa<hw::TypeAliasType>(srcType) || isa<hw::TypeAliasType>(dstType))) {
5229 srcVal = hw::BitcastOp::create(builder, destVal.getType(), srcVal);
5230 }
5231 return TypeSwitch<Operation *, FailureOr<bool>>(destVal.getDefiningOp())
5232 .Case<hw::WireOp>([&](auto op) {
5233 maybeUnused(op.getInput());
5234 op.getInputMutable().assign(srcVal);
5235 return true;
5236 })
5237 .Case<seq::FirRegOp>([&](auto op) {
5238 maybeUnused(op.getNext());
5239 op.getNextMutable().assign(srcVal);
5240 return true;
5241 })
5242 .Case<hw::StructExtractOp, hw::ArrayGetOp>([](auto op) {
5243 // NOTE: msvc thinks `return op.emitOpError(...);` is ambiguous. So
5244 // return `failure()` separately.
5245 op.emitOpError("used as connect destination");
5246 return failure();
5247 })
5248 .Default([](auto) { return false; });
5249}
5250
5251LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(ConnectOp op) {
5252 auto dest = op.getDest();
5253 // The source can be a smaller integer, extend it as appropriate if so.
5254 auto destType = type_cast<FIRRTLBaseType>(dest.getType()).getPassiveType();
5255 auto srcVal = getLoweredAndExtendedValue(op.getSrc(), destType);
5256 if (!srcVal)
5257 return handleZeroBit(op.getSrc(), []() { return success(); });
5258
5259 auto destVal = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(dest);
5260 if (!destVal)
5261 return failure();
5262
5263 auto result = lowerConnect(destVal, srcVal);
5264 if (failed(result))
5265 return failure();
5266 if (*result)
5267 return success();
5268
5269 // If this connect is driving a value that is currently a backedge, record
5270 // that the source is the value of the backedge.
5271 if (updateIfBackedge(destVal, srcVal))
5272 return success();
5273
5274 if (!isa<hw::InOutType>(destVal.getType()))
5275 return op.emitError("destination isn't an inout type");
5276
5277 sv::AssignOp::create(builder, destVal, srcVal);
5278 return success();
5279}
5280
5281LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(MatchingConnectOp op) {
5282 auto dest = op.getDest();
5283 auto srcVal = getLoweredValue(op.getSrc());
5284 if (!srcVal)
5285 return handleZeroBit(op.getSrc(), []() { return success(); });
5286
5287 auto destVal = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(dest);
5288 if (!destVal)
5289 return failure();
5290
5291 auto result = lowerConnect(destVal, srcVal);
5292 if (failed(result))
5293 return failure();
5294 if (*result)
5295 return success();
5296
5297 // If this connect is driving a value that is currently a backedge, record
5298 // that the source is the value of the backedge.
5299 if (updateIfBackedge(destVal, srcVal))
5300 return success();
5301
5302 if (!isa<hw::InOutType>(destVal.getType()))
5303 return op.emitError("destination isn't an inout type");
5304
5305 sv::AssignOp::create(builder, destVal, srcVal);
5306 return success();
5307}

5309LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(ForceOp op) {
5310 if (circuitState.lowerToCore)
5311 return op.emitOpError("lower-to-core does not support firrtl.force");
5312
5313 auto srcVal = getLoweredValue(op.getSrc());
5314 if (!srcVal)
5315 return failure();
5316
5317 auto destVal = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getDest());
5318 if (!destVal)
5319 return failure();
5320
5321 if (!isa<hw::InOutType>(destVal.getType()))
5322 return op.emitError("destination isn't an inout type");
5323
5324 // #ifndef SYNTHESIS
5325 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
5326 addToIfDefBlock("SYNTHESIS", std::function<void()>(), [&]() {
5327 addToInitialBlock([&]() { sv::ForceOp::create(builder, destVal, srcVal); });
5328 });
5329 return success();
5330}
5331
5332LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(RefForceOp op) {
5333 if (circuitState.lowerToCore)
5334 return op.emitOpError("lower-to-core does not support firrtl.ref.force");
5335
5336 auto src = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getSrc());
5337 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getClock());
5338 auto pred = getLoweredValue(op.getPredicate());
5339 if (!src || !clock || !pred)
5340 return failure();
5341
5342 auto destVal = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getDest());
5343 if (!destVal)
5344 return failure();
5345
5346 // #ifndef SYNTHESIS
5347 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
5348 addToIfDefBlock("SYNTHESIS", std::function<void()>(), [&]() {
5349 addToAlwaysBlock(clock, [&]() {
5350 addIfProceduralBlock(
5351 pred, [&]() { sv::ForceOp::create(builder, destVal, src); });
5352 });
5353 });
5354 return success();
5355}

5360
5361 auto src = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getSrc());
5362 auto pred = getLoweredValue(op.getPredicate());
5363 if (!src || !pred)
5364 return failure();
5365
5366 auto destVal = getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(op.getDest());
5367 if (!destVal)
5368 return failure();
5369
5370 // #ifndef SYNTHESIS
5371 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
5372 addToIfDefBlock("SYNTHESIS", std::function<void()>(), [&]() {
5373 addToInitialBlock([&]() {
5374 addIfProceduralBlock(
5375 pred, [&]() { sv::ForceOp::create(builder, destVal, src); });
5376 });
5377 });
5378 return success();
5379}

5423
5424// Replace FIRRTL "special" substitutions {{..}} with verilog equivalents.
5425static LogicalResult resolveFormatString(Location loc,
5426 StringRef originalFormatString,
5427 ValueRange operands,
5428 StringAttr &result) {
5429 // Update the format string to replace "special" substitutions based on
5430 // substitution type and lower normal substitusion.
5431 SmallString<32> formatString;
5432 for (size_t i = 0, e = originalFormatString.size(), subIdx = 0; i != e; ++i) {
5433 char c = originalFormatString[i];
5434 switch (c) {
5435 // Maybe a "%?" normal substitution.
5436 case '%': {
5437 formatString.push_back(c);
5438
5439 // Parse the width specifier.
5440 SmallString<6> width;
5441 c = originalFormatString[++i];
5442 while (isdigit(c)) {
5443 width.push_back(c);
5444 c = originalFormatString[++i];
5445 }
5446
5447 // Parse the radix.
5448 switch (c) {
5449 // A normal substitution. If this is a radix specifier, include the width
5450 // if one exists.
5451 case 'b':
5452 case 'd':
5453 case 'x':
5454 if (!width.empty())
5455 formatString.append(width);
5456 [[fallthrough]];
5457 case 'c':
5458 ++subIdx;
5459 [[fallthrough]];
5460 default:
5461 formatString.push_back(c);
5462 }
5463 break;
5464 }
5465 // Maybe a "{{}}" special substitution.
5466 case '{': {
5467 // Not a special substituion.
5468 if (originalFormatString.slice(i, i + 4) != "{{}}") {
5469 formatString.push_back(c);
5470 break;
5471 }
5472 // Special substitution. Look at the defining op to know how to lower it.
5473 auto substitution = operands[subIdx++];
5474 assert(type_isa<FStringType>(substitution.getType()) &&
5475 "the operand for a '{{}}' substitution must be an 'fstring' type");
5476 auto result =
5477 TypeSwitch<Operation *, LogicalResult>(substitution.getDefiningOp())
5478 .template Case<TimeOp>([&](auto) {
5479 formatString.append("%0t");
5480 return success();
5481 })
5482 .template Case<HierarchicalModuleNameOp>([&](auto) {
5483 formatString.append("%m");
5484 return success();
5485 })
5486 .Default([&](auto) {
5487 emitError(loc, "has a substitution with an unimplemented "
5488 "lowering")
5489 .attachNote(substitution.getLoc())
5490 << "op with an unimplemented lowering is here";
5491 return failure();
5492 });
5493 if (failed(result))
5494 return failure();
5495 i += 3;
5496 break;
5497 }
5498 // Default is to let characters through.
5499 default:
5500 formatString.push_back(c);
5501 }
5502 }
5503
5504 result = StringAttr::get(loc->getContext(), formatString);
5505 return success();
5506}
5507
5508// Printf/FPrintf is a macro op that lowers to an sv.ifdef.procedural, an sv.if,
5509// and an sv.fwrite all nested together.
5510template <class T>
5511LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitPrintfLike(
5512 T op, const FileDescriptorInfo &fileDescriptorInfo, bool usePrintfCond) {
5513 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getClock());
5514 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getCond());
5515 if (!clock || !cond)
5516 return failure();
5517
5518 StringAttr formatString;
5519 if (failed(resolveFormatString(op.getLoc(), op.getFormatString(),
5520 op.getSubstitutions(), formatString)))
5521 return failure();
5522
5523 auto fn = [&](Value fd) {
5524 SmallVector<Value> operands;
5525 if (failed(loweredFmtOperands(op.getSubstitutions(), operands)))
5526 return failure();
5527 sv::FWriteOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), fd, formatString, operands);
5528 return success();
5529 };
5530
5531 return lowerStatementWithFd(fileDescriptorInfo, clock, cond, fn,
5532 usePrintfCond);
5533}
5534
5535LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(PrintFOp op) {
5536 if (!circuitState.lowerToCore)
5537 return visitPrintfLike(op, {}, true);
5538
5539 auto clock = getLoweredValue(op.getClock());
5540 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getCond());
5541 if (!clock || !cond)
5542 return failure();
5543
5544 auto formatString =
5545 lowerSimFormatString(op.getFormatString(), op.getSubstitutions());
5546 if (failed(formatString))
5547 return failure();
5548
5549 auto stderrOp = sim::StderrStreamOp::create(builder);
5550 sim::TriggeredOp::create(builder, clock, cond, [&] {
5551 sim::PrintFormattedProcOp::create(builder, *formatString, stderrOp);
5552 });
5553 return success();
5554}
5555
5556LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(FPrintFOp op) {
5557 if (circuitState.lowerToCore) {
5558 auto clock = getLoweredValue(op.getClock());
5559 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getCond());
5560 if (!clock || !cond)
5561 return failure();
5562
5563 auto fileFormatString = lowerSimFormatString(
5564 op.getOutputFileAttr(), op.getOutputFileSubstitutions());
5565 if (failed(fileFormatString))
5566 return failure();
5567
5568 auto formatString =
5569 lowerSimFormatString(op.getFormatString(), op.getSubstitutions());
5570 if (failed(formatString))
5571 return failure();
5572
5573 sim::TriggeredOp::create(builder, clock, cond, [&] {
5574 auto fileOp = sim::GetFileOp::create(builder, *fileFormatString);
5575 sim::PrintFormattedProcOp::create(builder, *formatString, fileOp);
5576 });
5577 return success();
5578 }
5579
5580 StringAttr outputFileAttr;
5581 if (failed(resolveFormatString(op.getLoc(), op.getOutputFileAttr(),
5582 op.getOutputFileSubstitutions(),
5583 outputFileAttr)))
5584 return failure();
5585
5586 FileDescriptorInfo outputFile(outputFileAttr,
5587 op.getOutputFileSubstitutions());
5588 return visitPrintfLike(op, outputFile, false);
5589}
5590
5591// FFlush lowers into $fflush statement.
5592LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(FFlushOp op) {
5593 if (circuitState.lowerToCore)
5594 return op.emitOpError("lower-to-core does not support firrtl.fflush yet");
5595
5596 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(op.getClock());
5597 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getCond());
5598 if (!clock || !cond)
5599 return failure();
5600
5601 auto fn = [&](Value fd) {
5602 sv::FFlushOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), fd);
5603 return success();
5604 };
5605
5606 if (!op.getOutputFileAttr())
5607 return lowerStatementWithFd({}, clock, cond, fn, false);
5608
5609 // If output file is specified, resolve the format string and lower it with a
5610 // file descriptor associated with the output file.
5611 StringAttr outputFileAttr;
5612 if (failed(resolveFormatString(op.getLoc(), op.getOutputFileAttr(),
5613 op.getOutputFileSubstitutions(),
5614 outputFileAttr)))
5615 return failure();
5616
5617 return lowerStatementWithFd(
5618 FileDescriptorInfo(outputFileAttr, op.getOutputFileSubstitutions()),
5619 clock, cond, fn, false);
5620}
5621
5622// Stop lowers into a nested series of behavioral statements plus $fatal
5623// or $finish.
5624LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(StopOp op) {
5625 auto clock = getLoweredValue(op.getClock());
5626 auto cond = getLoweredValue(op.getCond());
5627 if (!clock || !cond)
5628 return failure();
5629
5630 circuitState.usedStopCond = true;
5631 circuitState.addFragment(theModule, "STOP_COND_FRAGMENT");
5632
5633 Value stopCond =
5634 sv::MacroRefExprOp::create(builder, cond.getType(), "STOP_COND_");
5635 Value exitCond = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(stopCond, cond, true);
5636
5637 sim::ClockedTerminateOp::create(builder, clock, exitCond,
5638 /*success=*/op.getExitCode() == 0,
5639 /*verbose=*/true);
5640
5641 return success();
5642}
5643
5644/// Helper function to build an immediate assert operation based on the
5645/// original FIRRTL operation name. This reduces code duplication in
5646/// `lowerVerificationStatement`.
5647template <typename... Args>
5648static Operation *buildImmediateVerifOp(ImplicitLocOpBuilder &builder,
5649 StringRef opName, Args &&...args) {
5650 if (opName == "assert")
5651 return sv::AssertOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5652 if (opName == "assume")
5653 return sv::AssumeOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5654 if (opName == "cover")
5655 return sv::CoverOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5656 llvm_unreachable("unknown verification op");
5657}
5658
5659/// Helper function to build a concurrent assert operation based on the
5660/// original FIRRTL operation name. This reduces code duplication in
5661/// `lowerVerificationStatement`.
5662template <typename... Args>
5663static Operation *buildConcurrentVerifOp(ImplicitLocOpBuilder &builder,
5664 StringRef opName, Args &&...args) {
5665 if (opName == "assert")
5666 return sv::AssertConcurrentOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5667 if (opName == "assume")
5668 return sv::AssumeConcurrentOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5669 if (opName == "cover")
5670 return sv::CoverConcurrentOp::create(builder, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
5671 llvm_unreachable("unknown verification op");
5672}
5673
5674static verif::ClockEdge firrtlToVerifClockEdge(EventControl eventControl) {
5675 switch (eventControl) {
5676 case EventControl::AtPosEdge:
5677 return verif::ClockEdge::Pos;
5678 case EventControl::AtEdge:
5679 return verif::ClockEdge::Both;
5680 case EventControl::AtNegEdge:
5681 return verif::ClockEdge::Neg;
5682 }
5683 llvm_unreachable("unknown FIRRTL event control");
5684}
5685
5686LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerVerificationStatementToCore(
5687 Operation *op, StringRef labelPrefix, Value opClock, Value opPredicate,
5688 Value opEnable, StringAttr opNameAttr, EventControl opEventControl) {
5689 auto guardsAttr = op->getAttrOfType<ArrayAttr>("guards");
5690 if (guardsAttr && !guardsAttr.empty())
5691 return op->emitOpError(
5692 "lower-to-core does not support guarded verification statements");
5693
5694 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(opClock);
5695 auto enable = getLoweredValue(opEnable);
5696 auto predicate = getLoweredValue(opPredicate);
5697 if (!clock || !enable || !predicate)
5698 return failure();
5699
5700 StringAttr label;
5701 if (opNameAttr && !opNameAttr.getValue().empty())
5702 label = StringAttr::get(builder.getContext(),
5703 labelPrefix + opNameAttr.getValue());
5704
5705 auto edge = firrtlToVerifClockEdge(opEventControl);
5706 auto opName = op->getName().stripDialect();
5707 if (opName == "assert") {
5708 verif::ClockedAssertOp::create(builder, predicate, edge, clock, enable,
5709 label);
5710 return success();
5711 }
5712 if (opName == "assume") {
5713 verif::ClockedAssumeOp::create(builder, predicate, edge, clock, enable,
5714 label);
5715 return success();
5716 }
5717 if (opName == "cover") {
5718 verif::ClockedCoverOp::create(builder, predicate, edge, clock, enable,
5719 label);
5720 return success();
5721 }
5722 llvm_unreachable("unknown verification op");
5723}
5724
5725/// Template for lowering verification statements from type A to
5726/// type B.
5727///
5728/// For example, lowering the "foo" op to the "bar" op would start
5729/// with:
5730///
5731/// foo(clock, condition, enable, "message")
5732///
5733/// This becomes a Verilog clocking block with the "bar" op guarded
5734/// by an if enable:
5735///
5736/// always @(posedge clock) begin
5737/// if (enable) begin
5738/// bar(condition);
5739/// end
5740/// end
5741/// The above can also be reduced into a concurrent verification statement
5742/// sv.assert.concurrent posedge %clock (condition && enable)
5743LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::lowerVerificationStatement(
5744 Operation *op, StringRef labelPrefix, Value opClock, Value opPredicate,
5745 Value opEnable, StringAttr opMessageAttr, ValueRange opOperands,
5746 StringAttr opNameAttr, bool isConcurrent, EventControl opEventControl) {
5747 if (circuitState.lowerToCore)
5748 return lowerVerificationStatementToCore(op, labelPrefix, opClock,
5749 opPredicate, opEnable, opNameAttr,
5750 opEventControl);
5751
5752 StringRef opName = op->getName().stripDialect();
5753
5754 // The attribute holding the compile guards
5755 ArrayRef<Attribute> guards{};
5756 if (auto guardsAttr = op->template getAttrOfType<ArrayAttr>("guards"))
5757 guards = guardsAttr.getValue();
5758
5759 auto isCover = isa<CoverOp>(op);
5760 auto clock = getLoweredNonClockValue(opClock);
5761 auto enable = getLoweredValue(opEnable);
5762 auto predicate = getLoweredValue(opPredicate);
5763 if (!clock || !enable || !predicate)
5764 return failure();
5765
5766 StringAttr label;
5767 if (opNameAttr && !opNameAttr.getValue().empty())
5768 label = opNameAttr;
5769 StringAttr prefixedLabel;
5770 if (label)
5771 prefixedLabel =
5772 StringAttr::get(builder.getContext(), labelPrefix + label.getValue());
5773
5774 StringAttr message;
5775 SmallVector<Value> messageOps;
5776 VerificationFlavor flavor = circuitState.verificationFlavor;
5777
5778 // For non-assertion, rollback to per-op configuration.
5779 if (flavor == VerificationFlavor::IfElseFatal && !isa<AssertOp>(op))
5780 flavor = VerificationFlavor::None;
5781
5782 if (flavor == VerificationFlavor::None) {
5783 // TODO: This should *not* be part of the op, but rather a lowering
5784 // option that the user of this pass can choose.
5785
5786 auto format = op->getAttrOfType<StringAttr>("format");
5787 // if-else-fatal iff concurrent and the format is specified.
5788 if (isConcurrent && format && format.getValue() == "ifElseFatal") {
5789 if (!isa<AssertOp>(op))
5790 return op->emitError()
5791 << "ifElseFatal format cannot be used for non-assertions";
5792 flavor = VerificationFlavor::IfElseFatal;
5793 } else if (isConcurrent)
5794 flavor = VerificationFlavor::SVA;
5795 else
5796 flavor = VerificationFlavor::Immediate;
5797 }
5798
5799 if (!isCover && opMessageAttr && !opMessageAttr.getValue().empty()) {
5800 // Resolve format string to handle special substitutions like
5801 // {{HierarchicalModuleName}} which should be replaced with %m.
5802 if (failed(resolveFormatString(op->getLoc(), opMessageAttr.getValue(),
5803 opOperands, message)))
5804 return failure();
5805
5806 if (failed(loweredFmtOperands(opOperands, messageOps)))
5807 return failure();
5808
5809 if (flavor == VerificationFlavor::SVA) {
5810 // For SVA assert/assume statements, wrap any message ops in $sampled() to
5811 // guarantee that these will print with the same value as when the
5812 // assertion triggers. (See SystemVerilog 2017 spec section 16.9.3 for
5813 // more information.)
5814 for (auto &loweredValue : messageOps)
5815 loweredValue = sv::SampledOp::create(builder, loweredValue);
5816 }
5817 }
5818
5819 auto emit = [&]() {
5820 switch (flavor) {
5821 case VerificationFlavor::Immediate: {
5822 // Handle the purely procedural flavor of the operation.
5823 auto deferImmediate = circt::sv::DeferAssertAttr::get(
5824 builder.getContext(), circt::sv::DeferAssert::Immediate);
5825 addToAlwaysBlock(clock, [&]() {
5826 addIfProceduralBlock(enable, [&]() {
5827 buildImmediateVerifOp(builder, opName, predicate, deferImmediate,
5828 prefixedLabel, message, messageOps);
5829 });
5830 });
5831 return;
5832 }
5833 case VerificationFlavor::IfElseFatal: {
5834 assert(isa<AssertOp>(op) && "only assert is expected");
5835 // Handle the `ifElseFatal` format, which does not emit an SVA but
5836 // rather a process that uses $error and $fatal to perform the checks.
5837 auto boolType = IntegerType::get(builder.getContext(), 1);
5838 predicate = comb::createOrFoldNot(builder, predicate, /*twoState=*/true);
5839 predicate = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(enable, predicate, true);
5840
5841 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
5842 addToIfDefBlock("SYNTHESIS", {}, [&]() {
5843 addToAlwaysBlock(clock, [&]() {
5844 addIfProceduralBlock(predicate, [&]() {
5845 circuitState.usedStopCond = true;
5846 circuitState.addFragment(theModule, "STOP_COND_FRAGMENT");
5847
5848 circuitState.usedAssertVerboseCond = true;
5849 circuitState.addFragment(theModule, "ASSERT_VERBOSE_COND_FRAGMENT");
5850
5851 addIfProceduralBlock(
5852 sv::MacroRefExprOp::create(builder, boolType,
5853 "ASSERT_VERBOSE_COND_"),
5854 [&]() {
5855 sv::ErrorProceduralOp::create(builder, message, messageOps);
5856 });
5857 addIfProceduralBlock(
5858 sv::MacroRefExprOp::create(builder, boolType, "STOP_COND_"),
5859 [&]() { sv::FatalProceduralOp::create(builder); });
5860 });
5861 });
5862 });
5863 return;
5864 }
5865 case VerificationFlavor::SVA: {
5866 // Formulate the `enable -> predicate` as `!enable | predicate`.
5867 // Except for covers, combine them: enable & predicate
5868 if (!isCover) {
5869 auto notEnable =
5870 comb::createOrFoldNot(builder, enable, /*twoState=*/true);
5871 predicate =
5872 builder.createOrFold<comb::OrOp>(notEnable, predicate, true);
5873 } else {
5874 predicate = builder.createOrFold<comb::AndOp>(enable, predicate, true);
5875 }
5876
5877 // Handle the regular SVA case.
5878 sv::EventControl event;
5879 switch (opEventControl) {
5880 case EventControl::AtPosEdge:
5881 event = circt::sv::EventControl::AtPosEdge;
5882 break;
5883 case EventControl::AtEdge:
5884 event = circt::sv::EventControl::AtEdge;
5885 break;
5886 case EventControl::AtNegEdge:
5887 event = circt::sv::EventControl::AtNegEdge;
5888 break;
5889 }
5890
5891 buildConcurrentVerifOp(
5892 builder, opName,
5893 circt::sv::EventControlAttr::get(builder.getContext(), event), clock,
5894 predicate, prefixedLabel, message, messageOps);
5895 return;
5896 }
5897 case VerificationFlavor::None:
5898 llvm_unreachable(
5899 "flavor `None` must be converted into one of concreate flavors");
5900 }
5901 };
5902
5903 // Wrap the verification statement up in the optional preprocessor
5904 // guards. This is a bit awkward since we want to translate an array of
5905 // guards into a recursive call to `addToIfDefBlock`.
5906 return emitGuards(op->getLoc(), guards, emit);
5907}
5908
5909// Lower an assert to SystemVerilog.
5910LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(AssertOp op) {
5911 return lowerVerificationStatement(
5912 op, "assert__", op.getClock(), op.getPredicate(), op.getEnable(),
5913 op.getMessageAttr(), op.getSubstitutions(), op.getNameAttr(),
5914 op.getIsConcurrent(), op.getEventControl());
5915}

5917// Lower an assume to SystemVerilog.
5918LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(AssumeOp op) {
5919 return lowerVerificationStatement(
5920 op, "assume__", op.getClock(), op.getPredicate(), op.getEnable(),
5921 op.getMessageAttr(), op.getSubstitutions(), op.getNameAttr(),
5922 op.getIsConcurrent(), op.getEventControl());
5923}
5924
5925// Lower a cover to SystemVerilog.
5926LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(CoverOp op) {
5927 return lowerVerificationStatement(
5928 op, "cover__", op.getClock(), op.getPredicate(), op.getEnable(),
5929 op.getMessageAttr(), op.getSubstitutions(), op.getNameAttr(),

5932
5933// Lower an UNR only assume to a specific style of SV assume.
5934LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(UnclockedAssumeIntrinsicOp op) {
5935 if (circuitState.lowerToCore) {
5936 auto guardsAttr = op->getAttrOfType<mlir::ArrayAttr>("guards");
5937 if (guardsAttr && !guardsAttr.empty())
5938 return op.emitOpError(
5939 "lower-to-core does not support guarded verification statements");
5940
5941 auto predicate = getLoweredValue(op.getPredicate());
5942 auto enable = getLoweredValue(op.getEnable());
5943 if (!predicate || !enable)
5944 return failure();
5945
5946 auto label = op.getNameAttr();
5947 StringAttr assumeLabel;
5948 if (label && !label.empty())
5949 assumeLabel =
5950 StringAttr::get(builder.getContext(), "assume__" + label.getValue());
5951 verif::AssumeOp::create(builder, predicate, enable, assumeLabel);
5952 return success();
5953 }
5954
5955 // TODO : Need to figure out if there is a cleaner way to get the string which
5956 // indicates the assert is UNR only. Or better - not rely on this at all -
5957 // ideally there should have been some other attribute which indicated that
5958 // this assert for UNR only.
5959 auto guardsAttr = op->getAttrOfType<mlir::ArrayAttr>("guards");
5960 ArrayRef<Attribute> guards =
5961 guardsAttr ? guardsAttr.getValue() : ArrayRef<Attribute>();
5962
5963 auto label = op.getNameAttr();
5964 StringAttr assumeLabel;
5965 if (label && !label.empty())
5966 assumeLabel =
5967 StringAttr::get(builder.getContext(), "assume__" + label.getValue());
5968 auto predicate = getLoweredValue(op.getPredicate());
5969 auto enable = getLoweredValue(op.getEnable());
5970 auto notEnable = comb::createOrFoldNot(builder, enable, /*twoState=*/true);
5971 predicate = builder.createOrFold<comb::OrOp>(notEnable, predicate, true);
5972
5973 SmallVector<Value> messageOps;
5974 for (auto operand : op.getSubstitutions()) {
5975 auto loweredValue = getLoweredValue(operand);
5976 if (!loweredValue) {
5977 // If this is a zero bit operand, just pass a one bit zero.
5978 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(operand.getType()))
5979 return failure();
5980 loweredValue = getOrCreateIntConstant(1, 0);
5981 }
5982 messageOps.push_back(loweredValue);
5983 }
5984 return emitGuards(op.getLoc(), guards, [&]() {
5985 sv::AlwaysOp::create(
5986 builder, ArrayRef(sv::EventControl::AtEdge), ArrayRef(predicate),
5987 [&]() {
5988 if (op.getMessageAttr().getValue().empty())
5989 buildImmediateVerifOp(
5990 builder, "assume", predicate,
5991 circt::sv::DeferAssertAttr::get(
5992 builder.getContext(), circt::sv::DeferAssert::Immediate),
5993 assumeLabel);
5994 else
5995 buildImmediateVerifOp(
5996 builder, "assume", predicate,
5997 circt::sv::DeferAssertAttr::get(
5998 builder.getContext(), circt::sv::DeferAssert::Immediate),
5999 assumeLabel, op.getMessageAttr(), messageOps);
6000 });
6001 });
6002}
6003
6004LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(AttachOp op) {
6005 // Don't emit anything for a zero or one operand attach.
6006 if (op.getAttached().size() < 2)
6007 return success();
6008
6009 SmallVector<Value, 4> inoutValues;
6010 for (auto v : op.getAttached()) {
6011 inoutValues.push_back(getPossiblyInoutLoweredValue(v));
6012 if (!inoutValues.back()) {
6013 // Ignore zero bit values.
6014 if (!isZeroBitFIRRTLType(v.getType()))
6015 return failure();
6016 inoutValues.pop_back();
6017 continue;
6018 }
6019
6020 if (!isa<hw::InOutType>(inoutValues.back().getType()))
6021 return op.emitError("operand isn't an inout type");
6022 }
6023
6024 if (inoutValues.size() < 2)
6025 return success();
6026
6027 // If the op has a single source value, the value is used as a lowering result
6028 // of other values. Therefore we can delete the attach op here.
6029 if (getSingleNonInstanceOperand(op))
6030 return success();
6031
6032 if (circuitState.lowerToCore)
6033 return op.emitOpError(
6034 "lower-to-core does not support firrtl.attach that requires SV "
6035 "lowering");
6036
6037 // If all operands of the attach are internal to this module (none of them
6038 // are ports), then they can all be replaced with a single wire, and we can
6039 // delete the attach op.
6040 bool isAttachInternalOnly =
6041 llvm::none_of(inoutValues, [](auto v) { return isa<BlockArgument>(v); });
6042
6043 if (isAttachInternalOnly) {
6044 auto v0 = inoutValues.front();
6045 for (auto v : inoutValues) {
6046 if (v == v0)
6047 continue;
6048 v.replaceAllUsesWith(v0);
6049 }
6050 return success();
6051 }
6052
6053 // If the attach operands contain a port, then we can't do anything to
6054 // simplify the attach operation.
6055 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("SYNTHESIS"));
6056 circuitState.addMacroDecl(builder.getStringAttr("VERILATOR"));
6057 addToIfDefBlock(
6058 "SYNTHESIS",
6059 // If we're doing synthesis, we emit an all-pairs assign complex.
6060 [&]() {
6061 SmallVector<Value, 4> values;
6062 for (auto inoutValue : inoutValues)
6063 values.push_back(getReadValue(inoutValue));
6064
6065 for (size_t i1 = 0, e = inoutValues.size(); i1 != e; ++i1) {
6066 for (size_t i2 = 0; i2 != e; ++i2)
6067 if (i1 != i2)
6068 sv::AssignOp::create(builder, inoutValues[i1], values[i2]);
6069 }
6070 },
6071 // In the non-synthesis case, we emit a SystemVerilog alias
6072 // statement.
6073 [&]() {
6074 sv::IfDefOp::create(
6075 builder, "VERILATOR",
6076 [&]() {
6077 sv::VerbatimOp::create(
6078 builder,
6079 "`error \"Verilator does not support alias and thus "
6080 "cannot "
6081 "arbitrarily connect bidirectional wires and ports\"");
6082 },
6083 [&]() { sv::AliasOp::create(builder, inoutValues); });
6084 });
6085
6086 return success();
6087}
6088
6089LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::visitStmt(BindOp op) {
6090 sv::BindOp::create(builder, op.getInstanceAttr());
6091 return success();
6092}
6093
6094LogicalResult FIRRTLLowering::fixupLTLOps() {
6095 if (ltlOpFixupWorklist.empty())
6096 return success();
6097 LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Fixing up " << ltlOpFixupWorklist.size()
6098 << " LTL ops\n");
6099
6100 // Add wire users into the worklist.
6101 for (unsigned i = 0, e = ltlOpFixupWorklist.size(); i != e; ++i)
6102 for (auto *user : ltlOpFixupWorklist[i]->getUsers())
6103 if (isa<hw::WireOp>(user))
6104 ltlOpFixupWorklist.insert(user);
6105
6106 // Re-infer LTL op types and remove wires.
6107 while (!ltlOpFixupWorklist.empty()) {
6108 auto *op = ltlOpFixupWorklist.pop_back_val();
6109
6110 // Update the operation's return type by re-running type inference.
6111 if (auto opIntf = dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::InferTypeOpInterface>(op)) {
6112 LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "- Update " << *op << "\n");
6113 SmallVector<Type, 2> types;
6114 auto result = opIntf.inferReturnTypes(
6115 op->getContext(), op->getLoc(), op->getOperands(),
6116 op->getAttrDictionary(), op->getPropertiesStorage(), op->getRegions(),
6117 types);
6118 if (failed(result))
6119 return failure();
6120 assert(types.size() == op->getNumResults());
6121
6122 // Update the result types and add the dependent ops into the worklist if
6123 // the type changed.
6124 for (auto [result, type] : llvm::zip(op->getResults(), types)) {
6125 if (result.getType() == type)
6126 continue;
6127 LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
6128 << " - Result #" << result.getResultNumber() << " from "
6129 << result.getType() << " to " << type << "\n");
6130 result.setType(type);
6131 for (auto *user : result.getUsers())
6132 if (user != op)
6133 ltlOpFixupWorklist.insert(user);
6134 }
6135 }
6136
6137 // Remove LTL-typed wires.
6138 if (auto wireOp = dyn_cast<hw::WireOp>(op)) {
6139 if (isa<ltl::SequenceType, ltl::PropertyType>(wireOp.getType())) {
6140 wireOp.replaceAllUsesWith(wireOp.getInput());
6141 LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "- Remove " << wireOp << "\n");
6142 if (wireOp.use_empty())
6143 wireOp.erase();
6144 }
6145 continue;
6146 }
6147
6148 // Ensure that the operation has no users outside of LTL operations.
6149 SmallPtrSet<Operation *, 4> usersReported;
6150 for (auto *user : op->getUsers()) {
6151 if (!usersReported.insert(user).second)
6152 continue;
6153 if (isa_and_nonnull<ltl::LTLDialect, verif::VerifDialect>(
6154 user->getDialect()))
6155 continue;
6156 if (isa<hw::WireOp>(user))
6157 continue;
6158 auto d = op->emitError(
6159 "verification operation used in a non-verification context");
6160 d.attachNote(user->getLoc())
6161 << "leaking outside verification context here";
6162 return d;
6163 }
6164 }
6165
6166 return success();
6167}
